1.9.e: A Brāhmaṇa (begets) on a female of the Kshatriya caste a Brāhmaṇa, on a female of the Vaiśya caste an Ambash th a, on a female of the Śūdra caste a Nishāda,
A Kshatriya (begets) on a female of the Vaiśya caste a Kshatriya, on a female of the Śūdra caste an Ugra.
A Vaiśya (begets) on a female of the Śūdra caste a Rathakāra.

1.9.s: śūdrād vaiśyāyāṃ māgadhaḥ kṣatriyāyāṃ kṣattābrāhmaṇyāṃ caṇḍālaḥ |
1.9.d: शूद्राद् वैश्यायां मागधः क्षत्रियायां क्षत्ताब्राह्मण्यां चण्डालः ।
1.9.e: A Śūdra begets on a female of the Vaiśya caste a Māgadha, on a female of the Kshatriya caste a Kshatt ri , but on a female of the Brāhmaṇa caste a K aṇd āla.

1.9.s: vaiśyāt kṣatriyāyām āyogavo brāhmaṇyāṃ vaidehakaḥ | kṣatriyād brāhmaṇyāṃ sūtaḥ |
1.9.d: वैश्यात् क्षत्रियायाम् आयोगवो ब्राह्मण्यां वैदेहकः । क्षत्रियाद् ब्राह्मण्यां सूतः ।
1.9.e: A Vaiśya begets on a female of the Kshatriya caste an Āyogava, on a female of the Brāhmaṇa caste a Sūta.
If among these an Ambash th a (male) and an Ugra (female) unite, (their son) will be born in the direct order of the castes (Anuloma).
If a Kshatt ri (male) and a Vaidehaka (female) unite, (their son will be) born against the order of the castes (Pratiloma).
An Ugra (begets) on a female of the Kshatt ri caste a Śvapāka,
A Vaidehaka on a female of the Ambash th a caste a Vaiṇa,
A Nishāda on a female of the Śūdra caste a Pulkasa,
A Śūdra on a female of the Nishāda caste a Kukkuṭaka.

1.9.s: varṇasaṃkarād utpannān vrātyān āhur manīṣiṇaḥ | vrātyān āhur manīṣiṇa iti |
1.9.d: वर्णसंकराद् उत्पन्नान् व्रात्यान् आहुर् मनीषिणः । व्रात्यान् आहुर् मनीषिण इति ।
1.9.e: The wise declare those sprung from an inter-mixture of the castes to be Vrātyas.

1.10.e: Let the king protect (his) subjects, receiving as his pay a sixth part (of their incomes or spiritual merit).

1.10.s: brahma vai svaṃ mahimānaṃ brāhmaṇeṣv adadhādadhyayanādhyāpanayajanayājanadānapratigrahasaṃyuktaṃ vedānāṃguptyai |
1.10.d: ब्रह्म वै स्वं महिमानं ब्राह्मणेष्व् अदधादध्ययनाध्यापनयजनयाजनदानप्रतिग्रहसंयुक्तं वेदानांगुप्त्यै ।
1.10.e: Brahman, forsooth, placed its majesty in the Brāhmaṇas, together with (the duties and privileges of) studying, teaching, sacrificing for themselves, sacrificing for others, liberality, and accepting (gifts), for the protection of the Vedas;

In the Kshatriyas (it placed) strength, together with (the duties and privileges of) studying, sacrificing, liberality, (using) weapons, and protecting the treasure (and the life of) created beings, for the growth of (good) government;

In the Vaiśyas (it placed the power of work), together with (the duties of) studying, sacrificing, liberality, cultivating (the soil), trading, and tending cattle, for the growth of (productive) labour.
On the Śūdras (it imposed the duty of) serving the three higher (castes).
For (the Veda states), 'they were created from the feet (of Brahman).'
Let (the king) choose a domestic priest (who shall be) foremost in all (transactions).
Let him act according to his instructions.
Let him not turn back in battle.

1.10.s: na karṇibhir na digdhaiḥ praharet || | bhītamattonmattapramattavisaṃnāhastrībālavṛddhabrāhmaṇair na yudhyeta |
1.10.d: न कर्णिभिर् न दिग्धैः प्रहरेत् ॥ । भीतमत्तोन्मत्तप्रमत्तविसंनाहस्त्रीबालवृद्धब्राह्मणैर् न युध्येत ।

1.10.e: Excepting assassins (ātatāyin).

1.10.s: athāpy udāharanti | adhyāpakaṃ kule jātaṃ yo hanyād ātatāyinam | na tena bhrūṇahā bhavati manyus tan manyum ṛcchati || iti |
1.10.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अध्यापकं कुले जातं यो हन्याद् आततायिनम् । न तेन भ्रूणहा भवति मन्युस् तन् मन्युम् ऋच्छति ॥ इति ।
1.10.e: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'He who slays an assassin, able to teach (the Veda) and born in a (noble) family, does not (incur) by that (act the guilt of) the murderer of a learned Brāhmaṇa; (in) that (case) fury recoils upon fury.'

1.10.s: sāmudraśulko varaṃ rūpam uddhṛtya daśapaṇaṃ śatam |
1.10.d: सामुद्रशुल्को वरं रूपम् उद्धृत्य दशपणं शतम् ।
1.10.e: The duty on goods imported by sea is, after deducting a choice article, ten Paṇas in the hundred.
Let him also lay just (duties) on other (marketable goods) according to their intrinsic value without oppressing (the traders).

1.10.s: abrāhmaṇasya pranaṣṭasvāmikaṃ rikthaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ paripālya rājā haret |
1.10.d: अब्राह्मणस्य प्रनष्टस्वामिकं रिक्थं संवत्सरं परिपाल्य राजा हरेत् ।
1.10.e: Let the king guard the property of men belonging to a non-Brāhmanical caste, the owner of which has disappeared, during a year, and afterwards take it (for himself).
A Brāhmaṇa, forsooth, shall not suffer corporal punishment for any offence.

1.10.d: ब्राह्मणस्यब्रह्महत्यागुरुतल्पगमनसुवर्णस्तेयसुरापानेषु कुसिन्धभगसृगालसुराध्वजांस् तप्तेनायसा ललाटे ऽङ्कयित्वा विषयान् निर्धमनम् ।
1.10.e: In case (a Brāhmaṇa) has slain a Brāhmaṇa, has violated his Guru's bed, has stolen the gold (of a Brāhmaṇa), or has drunk (the spirituous liquor called) Surā, (the king) shall cause to be impressed with a heated iron the mark of a headless trunk, a female part, a jackal, (or) the sign of a tavern on the forehead (of the offender) and banish him from his realm.
If a Kshatriya or (a man of any) other (lower caste) has murdered a Brāhmaṇa, death and the confiscation of all his property (shall be his punishment).

1.10.s: teṣām eva tulyāpakṛṣṭavadhe yathābalam anurūpāndaṇḍān prakalpayet |
1.10.d: तेषाम् एव तुल्यापकृष्टवधे यथाबलम् अनुरूपान्दण्डान् प्रकल्पयेत् ।
1.10.e: If those same (persons) slay men of equal or lower castes, (the king) shall fix suitable punishments in accordance with their ability.
For slaying a Kshatriya (the offender) shall give to the king one thousand cows and besides a bull in expiation of his sin,

1.10.s: śataṃ vaiśye daśa śūdra ṛṣabhaś cātrādhikaḥ |
1.10.d: शतं वैश्ये दश शूद्र ऋषभश् चात्राधिकः ।
1.10.e: For (slaying) a Vaiśya one hundred cows, for (slaying) a Śūdra ten; and a bull (must be) added (in each case).

1.10.s: śūdravadhena strīvadho govadhaś cavyākhyāto 'nyatrātreyyā vadhād dhenvanaḍuhoś ca |
1.10.d: शूद्रवधेन स्त्रीवधो गोवधश् चव्याख्यातो ऽन्यत्रात्रेय्या वधाद् धेन्वनडुहोश् च ।
1.10.e: (The punishment for) the murder of a woman--excepting a (Brāhmaṇī) who had bathed after temporary uncleanness--and for the destruction of a cow have been explained by the (rule regarding the) murder of a Śūdra.
If he has slain a milch-cow or a draught-ox, he shall perform a K āndrāyaṇa (lunar penance) after (paying the prescribed fine).

1.10.s: lokasaṃgrahaṇārthaṃ yathā dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ vā sākṣīsākṣyaṃ brūyāt |
1.10.d: लोकसंग्रहणार्थं यथा दृष्टं श्रुतं वा साक्षीसाक्ष्यं ब्रूयात् ।
1.10.e: In order to gain the good opinion of men, a witness shall give evidence in accordance with what he has seen or heard.

1.10.s: pādo 'dharmasya kartāraṃ pādo gacchati sākṣiṇam | pādaḥ sabhāsadaḥ sarvān pādo rājānam ṛcchati | rājā bhavaty anenāś ca mucyante ca sabhāsadaḥ | eno gacchati kartāraṃ yatra nindyo ha nindyate |
1.10.d: पादो ऽधर्मस्य कर्तारं पादो गच्छति साक्षिणम् । पादः सभासदः सर्वान् पादो राजानम् ऋच्छति । राजा भवत्य् अनेनाश् च मुच्यन्ते च सभासदः । एनो गच्छति कर्तारं यत्र निन्द्यो ह निन्द्यते ।
1.10.e: Of injustice (in decisions) one quarter falls on the party in the cause, one quarter on his witnesses, one quarter on all the judges, and one quarter on the king. But where he who deserves condemnation is condemned, the king is guiltless and the judges free from blame; the guilt falls on the offender (alone).

1.10.s: sākṣiṇaṃ caivam uddiṣṭaṃ yatnāt pṛcched vicakṣaṇaḥ |
1.10.d: साक्षिणं चैवम् उद्दिष्टं यत्नात् पृच्छेद् विचक्षणः ।
1.10.e: (Therefore) a wise man should ask an appointed witness in the following manner:

1.10.s: yāṃ rātrim ajaniṣṭhās tvaṃ yāṃ ca rātriṃ mariṣyasi | etayor antarā yat te sukṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ bhavet | tat sarvaṃ rājagāmi syād anṛtaṃ bruvatas tava |
1.10.d: यां रात्रिम् अजनिष्ठास् त्वं यां च रात्रिं मरिष्यसि । एतयोर् अन्तरा यत् ते सुकृतं सुकृतं भवेत् । तत् सर्वं राजगामि स्याद् अनृतं ब्रुवतस् तव ।
1.10.e: 'The merit which thou hast acquired in the interval between the night in which thou wast born and that in which thou wilt die, all that will go to the king, if thou speakest an untruth.'

1.10.s: trīn eva ca pitqn hanti trīn eva ca pitāmahān | sapta jātān ajātāṃś ca sākṣī sākṣyaṃ mṛṣā vadan |
1.10.d: त्रीन् एव च पित्qन् हन्ति त्रीन् एव च पितामहान् । सप्त जातान् अजातांश् च साक्षी साक्ष्यं मृषा वदन् ।
1.10.e: 'A witness who speaks falsely, slays three fathers and three grandfathers and seven (descendants), both the born and the unborn.'

1.10.s: hiraṇyārthe anṛte hanti trīn eva ca pitāmahān | pañca paśvanṛte hanti daśa hanti gavānṛte | śatam aśvānṛte hanti sahasraṃ puruṣānṛte | sarvaṃ bhūmyanṛte hanti sākṣī sākṣyaṃ mṛṣā vadan |
1.10.d: हिरण्यार्थे अनृते हन्ति त्रीन् एव च पितामहान् । पञ्च पश्वनृते हन्ति दश हन्ति गवानृते । शतम् अश्वानृते हन्ति सहस्रं पुरुषानृते । सर्वं भूम्यनृते हन्ति साक्षी साक्ष्यं मृषा वदन् ।
1.10.e: 'By false testimony concerning gold he kills three ancestors; by false testimony regarding (small) cattle he kills five; by false testimony concerning kine he kills ten.' 'He kills a hundred by false evidence regarding horses, (and) a thousand by false evidence concerning a man. A witness Who speaks falsely, destroys the whole (world) by false evidence concerning land.'
(Men of) the four castes (varṇa) who have sons may be witnesses excepting Śrotriyas, the king, ascetics, and those who are destitute of human (intellect).
If (the witness rightly) recollects (the facts of) the case (he will receive) commendation from the most eminent men.
In the contrary case (he will) fall into hell.

1.10.s: dvādaśarātraṃ taptaṃ payaḥ pibet kūśmāṇḍair vā juhuyād iti | kūśmāṇḍair vā juhuyād iti |
1.10.d: द्वादशरात्रं तप्तं पयः पिबेत् कूश्माण्डैर् वा जुहुयाद् इति । कूश्माण्डैर् वा जुहुयाद् इति ।
1.10.e: Let him (who has given false evidence), drink hot milk during twelve (days and) nights or offer burnt oblations (reciting) the Kūshmāṇd a (texts).

1.11.e: (There are) eight marriage-rites.

1.11.s: śrutaśīle vijñāya brahmacāriṇe 'rthine dīyate sa brāhmaḥ |
1.11.d: श्रुतशीले विज्ञाय ब्रह्मचारिणे ऽर्थिने दीयते स ब्राह्मः ।
1.11.e: If (the father) gives (his daughter) to a student (who has not broken his vow of chastity and) who asks for her, after fully enquiring into his learning and character, that (is) the rite .of Brahman (brāhma).

1.11.s: ācchādyālaṃkṛtya | eṣā saha dharmaś caryatām iti | prājāptyaḥ |
1.11.d: आच्छाद्यालंकृत्य । एषा सह धर्मश् चर्यताम् इति । प्राजाप्त्यः ।
1.11.e: If (the father gives his daughter away) after clothing her and decking her with ornaments, (saying) 'That (is thy wife), fulfil the law (with her),' that (is) the rite of Pra g āpati (prā g āpatya).
If (the bridegroom) after offering the first burnt oblation of parched grain (receives the maiden) for a bull and a cow, that is the rite of the Ri shis (ārsha).

1.11.s: dakṣiṇāsu nīyamānāsv antarvedy ṛtvije sa daivaḥ |
1.11.d: दक्षिणासु नीयमानास्व् अन्तर्वेद्य् ऋत्विजे स दैवः ।

1.11.s: suptāṃ mattāṃ pramattāṃ vopagacched iti paiśācaḥ |
1.11.d: सुप्तां मत्तां प्रमत्तां वोपगच्छेद् इति पैशाचः ।

1.11.s: teṣāṃ catvāraḥ pūrve brāhmaṇasya teṣv api pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥśreyān |
1.11.d: तेषां चत्वारः पूर्वे ब्राह्मणस्य तेष्व् अपि पूर्वः पूर्वःश्रेयान् ।

1.11.e: The fifth and the eighth (are lawful) for Vaiśyas and Śūdras.
For Vaiśyas and Śūdras are not particular about their wives,
Because they are allowed (to subsist by such low occupations as) husbandry and service.

1.11.s: gāndharvam apy eke praśaṃsanti sarveṣāṃ snehānugatatvāt |
1.11.d: गान्धर्वम् अप्य् एके प्रशंसन्ति सर्वेषां स्नेहानुगतत्वात् ।
1.11.e: Some recommend the Gāndharva rite for all (castes), because it is based on (mutual) affection.

1.11.s: yathā yukto vivāhas tathā yuktā prajā bhavatītivijñāyate |
1.11.d: यथा युक्तो विवाहस् तथा युक्ता प्रजा भवतीतिविज्ञायते ।
1.11.e: The Veda declares, The quality of the offspring depends on the quality of the marriage rite.'

1.11.s: athāpy udāharanti | krītā dravyeṇa yā nārī sā na patnī vidhīyate | sā na daive na sā pitrye dāsīṃ tāṃ kāśyapo 'bravīt |
1.11.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । क्रीता द्रव्येण या नारी सा न पत्नी विधीयते । सा न दैवे न सा पित्र्ये दासीं तां काश्यपो ऽब्रवीत् ।
1.11.e: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'It is declared that a female who has been purchased for money is not a wife. She cannot (assist) at sacrifices offered to the gods or the manes. Kāśyapa has stated that she is a slave.'

1.11.s: śulkena ye prayacchanti svasutāṃ lobhamohitāḥ | ātmavikrayiṇaḥ pāpā mahākilbiṣakārakāḥ | patanti narake ghore ghnanti cā saptamaṃ kulam | gamanāgamanaṃ caiva sarvaṃ śulke vidhīyate || | paurṇamasyaṣṭakāmāvāsyāgnyutpātabhūmikampaśmaśānadeśapatiśrotriyaikatīrthaprayāṇeṣv ahorātram anadhyāyaḥ |
1.11.d: शुल्केन ये प्रयच्छन्ति स्वसुतां लोभमोहिताः । आत्मविक्रयिणः पापा महाकिल्बिषकारकाः । पतन्ति नरके घोरे घ्नन्ति चा सप्तमं कुलम् । गमनागमनं चैव सर्वं शुल्के विधीयते ॥ । पौर्णमस्यष्टकामावास्याग्न्युत्पातभूमिकम्पश्मशानदेशपतिश्रोत्रियैकतीर्थप्रयाणेष्व् अहोरात्रम् अनध्यायः ।

1.11.s: vāte pūtigandhe nīhāre canṛttagītavāditraruditasāmaśabdeṣu tāvantaṃ kālam |
1.11.d: वाते पूतिगन्धे नीहारे चनृत्तगीतवादित्ररुदितसामशब्देषु तावन्तं कालम् ।
1.11.e: (The study of the Veda must be interrupted) while (a strong) wind (blows), a foul smell (is perceptible), or hoar-frost (lies on the ground), when dancing (is going on), and while the sounds of singing, musical instruments, weeping, or of the Sāman (melodies are audible).
When thunder, lightning, and rain come together, (the interruption shall last) three days except in the rainy season.

1.11.d: वर्षाकाले ऽपि वर्षवर्जम् अहोरात्रयोश् च तत्कालम् ।
1.11.e: In the rainy season, too, (the reading must be interrupted) until the same hour of the (next) day or night, (if thunder and lightning come together), not on account of rain.
If (he has) received anything or dined on the occasion of a sacrifice in honour of the manes, (he shall not read) during the remainder of the day,
(Nor) after meals until (the food) has been digested.
For the hand of a Brāhmaṇa is his mouth.

1.11.s: athāpy udāharanti | bhuktaṃ pratigṛhītaṃ ca nirviśeṣam iti śrutiḥ |
1.11.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । भुक्तं प्रतिगृहीतं च निर्विशेषम् इति श्रुतिः ।
1.11.e: Now they quote also (the following verse): According to the revealed texts there is no difference whether one has eaten or received (a present at a Śrāddha).'
(A student shall discontinue the study of the Veda) during three days in case his father has died.

1.11.s: dvayam u ha vai suśravaso 'nūcānasya retobrāhmaṇasyordhvaṃ nābher adhastād anyat | sa yad ūrdhvaṃ nābhestena haitat prajāyate yad brāhmaṇān upanayati yad adhyāpayati yad yājayati yat sādhu karoti | sarvāsyaiṣā prajā bhavati | atha yadavācīṇaṃ nābhes tena hāsyaurasī prajā bhavati | tasmāc chrotriyamanūcānam aprajo 'sīti na vadanti |
1.11.d: द्वयम् उ ह वै सुश्रवसो ऽनूचानस्य रेतोब्राह्मणस्योर्ध्वं नाभेर् अधस्ताद् अन्यत् । स यद् ऊर्ध्वं नाभेस्तेन हैतत् प्रजायते यद् ब्राह्मणान् उपनयति यद् अध्यापयति यद् याजयति यत् साधु करोति । सर्वास्यैषा प्रजा भवति । अथ यदवाचीणं नाभेस् तेन हास्यौरसी प्रजा भवति । तस्माच् छ्रोत्रियमनूचानम् अप्रजो ऽसीति न वदन्ति ।
1.11.e: 'Of two kinds, forsooth, is the virile energy of a famous Brāhmaṇa who is learned in the Vedas, (that which resides) above the navel and the other (that resides) below the' navel. Through that which (resides) above the navel, his offspring is produced when he initiates Brāhmaṇas, when he teaches them, when he causes them to offer sacrifices, when he makes them holy. All these are his children. But through that which resides below the navel the children of his body are produced. Therefore they never say to a Śrotriya who is versed in the Vedas, 'Thou art destitute of offspring.'

1.11.s: tasmād dvināmā dvimukho vipro dviretā dvijanmā ceti |
1.11.d: तस्माद् द्विनामा द्विमुखो विप्रो द्विरेता द्विजन्मा चेति ।
1.11.e: 'Therefore a Brāhmaṇa has two names, two mouths, two kinds of virile energy, and two births.'
(Let him discontinue the recitation of the Veda) as long as he is within hearing or sight of Śūdras and Apapātras.
When at night the howl of a solitary jackal is heard, he shall not study until he has slept.

1.11.s: ahorātrayoś ca saṃdhyayoḥ parvasu ca nādhīyīta |
1.11.d: अहोरात्रयोश् च संध्ययोः पर्वसु च नाधीयीत ।
1.11.e: Let him not study in the evening and morning twilights nor on the Parva-days.

1.11.s: na māṃsam aśnīyān na striyam upeyāt |
1.11.d: न मांसम् अश्नीयान् न स्त्रियम् उपेयात् ।
1.11.e: He shall not eat meat nor approach his wife (on those days).
It is declared in the Veda, 'For on the Parva-days the Rākshasas and the Piśā k as roam about (in order to injure men).'
And on (the appearance of) other omens and portents (he shall not repeat the Veda), except mentally, during a day and a night.
The mental recitation of the Veda must also be interrupted on births and deaths (occurring in the family).

1.11.s: athāpy udāharanti | hanty aṣṭamī hy upādhyāyaṃ hanti śiṣyaṃ caturdaśī | hanti pañcadaśī vidyāṃ tasmāt parvaṇi varjayet | tasmāt parvaṇi varjayed iti |
1.11.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । हन्त्य् अष्टमी ह्य् उपाध्यायं हन्ति शिष्यं चतुर्दशी । हन्ति पञ्चदशी विद्यां तस्मात् पर्वणि वर्जयेत् । तस्मात् पर्वणि वर्जयेद् इति ।
1.11.e: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'The eighth day destroys the teacher, the fourteenth destroys the pupil, the fifteenth destroys learning; therefore let him avoid (studying the Veda) on the Parva-days.'

2.1.s: athātaḥ prāyaścittāni |
2.1.d: अथातः प्रायश्चित्तानि ।
2.1.e: Now, therefore, the penances (will be described).

2.1.s: bhrūṇahā dvādaśa samāḥ |
2.1.d: भ्रूणहा द्वादश समाः ।
2.1.e: The murderer of a learned Brāhmaṇa (shall practise the following vow) during twelve years:

2.1.s: kapālī khaṭvāṅgī gardabhacarmavāsā araṇyaniketanaḥśmaśāne dhvajaṃ śavaśiraḥ kṛtvā kuṭīṃ kārayet | tām āvaset | saptāgārāṇi bhaikṣaṃ caran svakarmācakṣāṇas tena prāṇān dhārayet | alabdhvopavāsaḥ |
2.1.d: कपाली खट्वाङ्गी गर्दभचर्मवासा अरण्यनिकेतनःश्मशाने ध्वजं शवशिरः कृत्वा कुटीं कारयेत् । ताम् आवसेत् । सप्तागाराणि भैक्षं चरन् स्वकर्माचक्षाणस् तेन प्राणान् धारयेत् । अलब्ध्वोपवासः ।
2.1.e: Carrying a skull (instead of a dish) and the foot of a bedstead (instead of a staff), dressed in the hide of an ass, staying in the forest, making a dead man's skull his flag, he shall cause a hut to be built in a burial-ground and reside there; going to seven houses in order to beg food, while proclaiming his deed, he shall support life with what (he gets there), and shall fast if he obtains nothing;

2.1.s: aśvamedhena gosavenāgniṣṭutā vā yajeta |
2.1.d: अश्वमेधेन गोसवेनाग्निष्टुता वा यजेत ।
2.1.e: Or he may offer a horse-sacrifice, a Gosava, or an Agnishṭut

2.1.s: aśvamedhāvabhṛthe vātmānaṃ pāvayet |
2.1.d: अश्वमेधावभृथे वात्मानं पावयेत् ।
2.1.e: Or he may bathe (with the priests) on the completion of a horse-sacrifice (offered by somebody else).

2.1.s: athāpy udāharanti | amatyā brāhmaṇaṃ hatvā duṣṭo bhavati dharmataḥ | ṛṣayo niṣkṛtiṃ tasya vadanty amatipūrvake | matipūrvaṃ ghnatas tasya niṣkṛtir nopalabhyate |
2.1.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अमत्या ब्राह्मणं हत्वा दुष्टो भवति धर्मतः । ऋषयो निष्कृतिं तस्य वदन्त्य् अमतिपूर्वके । मतिपूर्वं घ्नतस् तस्य निष्कृतिर् नोपलभ्यते ।
2.1.e: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'He who unintentionally slays a Brāhmaṇa becomes sinful according to the sacred law. The sages declare that he may be purified (if he did it) unintentionally. But no expiation is found for a wilful murderer.'

2.1.s: apagūrya caret kṛcchram atikṛcchraṃ nipātane | kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caiva lohitasya pravartane | tasmān naivāpagureta na ca kurvīta śoṇitam || iti |
2.1.d: अपगूर्य चरेत् कृच्छ्रम् अतिकृच्छ्रं निपातने । कृच्छ्रं चान्द्रायणं चैव लोहितस्य प्रवर्तने । तस्मान् नैवापगुरेत न च कुर्वीत शोणितम् ॥ इति ।
2.1.e: He who has raised his hand (against a Brāhmaṇa), shall perform a K ri k kh ra penance, an Atik ri k kh ra penance if he strikes, a K ri k kh ra and a K āndrāyaṇa if blood flows. Therefore let him neither raise his hand nor cause blood to flow.'

2.1.s: nava samā rājanyasya |
2.1.d: नव समा राजन्यस्य ।
2.1.e: (For killing) a Kshatriya (he shall keep the normal vow of continence) during nine years,

2.1.s: tisro vaiśyasya |
2.1.d: तिस्रो वैश्यस्य ।
2.1.e: (For killing) a Vaiśya during three (years),

2.1.s: saṃvatsaraṃ śūdrasya |
2.1.d: संवत्सरं शूद्रस्य ।
2.1.e: (For killing) a Śūdra during one year,

2.1.s: striyāś ca |
2.1.d: स्त्रियाश् च ।
2.1.e: Likewise for killing a woman.

2.1.s: brāhmaṇavad ātreyyāḥ |
2.1.d: ब्राह्मणवद् आत्रेय्याः ।
2.1.e: (The penance for killing) a woman who has bathed after temporary uncleanness (is) the same (as that) for (the murder of) a Brāhmaṇa.

2.1.s: gurutalpagas tapte lohaśayane śayīta |
2.1.d: गुरुतल्पगस् तप्ते लोहशयने शयीत ।
2.1.e: He who has defiled the bed of a Guru shall place himself on a heated iron bed,

2.1.s: sūrmiṃ vā jvalantīṃ śliṣyet |
2.1.d: सूर्मिं वा ज्वलन्तीं श्लिष्येत् ।
2.1.e: Or embrace a red hot image (of a woman),

2.1.s: liṅgaṃ vā savṛṣaṇaṃ parivāsyāñjalāv ādhāyadakṣiṇāpratīcyor diśor antareṇa gacched ā nipatanāt |
2.1.d: लिङ्गं वा सवृषणं परिवास्याञ्जलाव् आधायदक्षिणाप्रतीच्योर् दिशोर् अन्तरेण गच्छेद् आ निपतनात् ।
2.1.e: Or cutting off his organ together with the testicles and holding them in his joined hands, he shall walk towards the south-west until he falls down (dead).

2.1.s: stenaḥ prakīrya keśān saidhrakam musalam ādāya skandhenarājānaṃ gacched anena māṃ jahīti | tenainaṃ hanyāt |
2.1.d: स्तेनः प्रकीर्य केशान् सैध्रकम् मुसलम् आदाय स्कन्धेनराजानं गच्छेद् अनेन मां जहीति । तेनैनं हन्यात् ।
2.1.e: A thief shall go to the king with flying hair, carrying on his shoulder a club of Sindhraka wood (and say), 'Strike me with that.' (Then the king) shall strike him.

2.1.s: athāpy udāharanti | skandhenādāya musalaṃ steno rājānam anviyāt | anena śādhi māṃ rājan kṣatradharmam anusmaran | śāsane vā visarge vā steno mucyeta kilbiṣāt | aśāsanāt tu tad rājā stenād āpnoti kilbiṣam || iti |
2.1.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । स्कन्धेनादाय मुसलं स्तेनो राजानम् अन्वियात् । अनेन शाधि मां राजन् क्षत्रधर्मम् अनुस्मरन् । शासने वा विसर्गे वा स्तेनो मुच्येत किल्बिषात् । अशासनात् तु तद् राजा स्तेनाद् आप्नोति किल्बिषम् ॥ इति ।
2.1.e: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'A thief shall go to the king carrying a club on his shoulder (and say to him), 'Punish me with that, O king, remembering the duty of Kshatriyas.' 'Whether he be punished or be pardoned, the thief is freed from his guilt. But if the king does not punish him, that guilt of the thief falls on him.'

2.1.s: surāṃ pītvoṣṇayā kāyaṃ dahet |
2.1.d: सुरां पीत्वोष्णया कायं दहेत् ।
2.1.e: If he has drunk (the spirituous liquor called) Surā, he shall scald himself to death with hot (liquor of the) same (kind).

2.1.s: amatyā pāne kṛcchrābdapādaṃ caret punarupanayanaṃ ca |
2.1.d: अमत्या पाने कृच्छ्राब्दपादं चरेत् पुनरुपनयनं च ।
2.1.e: For unintentionally drinking (Surā), he shall perform K ri k kh ra penances during three months and be initiated again,

2.1.s: vapanavrataniyamalopaś ca pūrvānuṣṭhitatvāt |
2.1.d: वपनव्रतनियमलोपश् च पूर्वानुष्ठितत्वात् ।
2.1.e: And (on this second initiation) the cutting (of the hair and nails), the vows, and (the observance of the) restrictive rules may be omitted.

2.1.s: athāpy udāharanti | amatyā vāruṇīṃ pītvā prāśya mūtrapurīṣayoḥ | brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ punaḥsaṃskāram arhati |
2.1.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अमत्या वारुणीं पीत्वा प्राश्य मूत्रपुरीषयोः । ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यः पुनःसंस्कारम् अर्हति ।
2.1.e: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'A Brāhmaṇa, Kshatriya, or Vaiśya who has unintentionally drunk (the spirituous liquor called) Vāruṇī or has swallowed urine or faeces must be initiated a second time.'

2.1.s: surādhāne tu yo bhāṇḍe apaḥ paryuṣitāḥ pibet | śaṅkhapuṣpīvipakvena ṣaḍahaṃ kṣīreṇa vartayet |
2.1.d: सुराधाने तु यो भाण्डे अपः पर्युषिताः पिबेत् । शङ्खपुष्पीविपक्वेन षडहं क्षीरेण वर्तयेत् ।
2.1.e: 'But he who drinks water which has stood in a vessel, used for keeping Surā, shall live six days on milk in which (leaves of) the Śaṅkhapushpī plant have been boiled.'

2.1.s: guruprayuktaś cen mriyeta gurus trīn kṛcchrāṃś caret |
2.1.d: गुरुप्रयुक्तश् चेन् म्रियेत गुरुस् त्रीन् कृच्छ्रांश् चरेत् ।
2.1.e: If (a pupil) who is employed by his teacher (on some errand) meets with his death, (the teacher) shall perform three K ri k kh ra penances.

2.1.s: etad evāsaṃskṛte |
2.1.d: एतद् एवासंस्कृते ।
2.1.e: The same (penance) is prescribed for not finishing (the education of the pupil).

2.1.s: brahmacāriṇaḥ śavakarmaṇā vratāvṛttir anyatramātāpitror ācāryāc ca |
2.1.d: ब्रह्मचारिणः शवकर्मणा व्रतावृत्तिर् अन्यत्रमातापित्रोर् आचार्याच् च ।
2.1.e: If a student assists at the burial of anybody except (at that of his) mother, of his father, or of his teacher, he must begin his vow afresh.

2.1.s: sa ced vyādhīyīta kāmaṃ guror ucchiṣṭaṃ bhaiṣajyārthesarvaṃ prāśnīyāt |
2.1.d: स चेद् व्याधीयीत कामं गुरोर् उच्छिष्टं भैषज्यार्थेसर्वं प्राश्नीयात् ।
2.1.e: If a (student) is sick, he may, at his pleasure, eat all the fragments of his teacher's meal as medicine.

2.1.s: yenecchet tena cikitset |
2.1.d: येनेच्छेत् तेन चिकित्सेत् ।
2.1.e: He may physic himself with any (medicine) which he may desire.

2.1.s: sa yadā gadī syāt tad utthāyādityam upatiṣṭheta | haṃsaḥ śuciṣad iti | etayā |
2.1.d: स यदा गदी स्यात् तद् उत्थायादित्यम् उपतिष्ठेत । हंसः शुचिषद् इति । एतया ।
2.1.e: When he is unable to move, he may worship the sun, after he has risen, reciting this ( Ri k verse): A swan, dwelling in purity.'

2.1.s: divā retaḥ siktvā trir apo hṛdayaṃgamāḥ pibed retasyābhiḥ |
2.1.d: दिवा रेतः सिक्त्वा त्रिर् अपो हृदयंगमाः पिबेद् रेतस्याभिः ।
2.1.e: When he has spent his manly strength in the day-time, let him thrice drink water that reaches his heart, reciting the verses which contain the word retas.

2.1.s: yo brahmacārī striyam upeyāt so 'vakīrṇī |
2.1.d: यो ब्रह्मचारी स्त्रियम् उपेयात् सो ऽवकीर्णी ।
2.1.e: A student who approaches a woman (is called) an Avakīrṇin,

2.1.s: sa gardabhaṃ paśum ālabheta |
2.1.d: स गर्दभं पशुम् आलभेत ।
2.1.e: Let him offer an ass (in the place of) a sacrificial animal.

2.1.s: nairṛtaḥ paśuḥ puroḍāśaś ca rakṣodevato yamadevato vā |
2.1.d: नैरृतः पशुः पुरोडाशश् च रक्षोदेवतो यमदेवतो वा ।
2.1.e: The sacrificial meat-cake (puroḍāsa shall be offered) to Nir ri ti, or to the Rākshasas, or to Yama.

2.1.s: śiśnāt prāśitram apsv avadānaiś carantīti vijñāyate |
2.1.d: शिश्नात् प्राशित्रम् अप्स्व् अवदानैश् चरन्तीति विज्ञायते ।
2.1.e: It is declared in the Veda, 'The piece to be eaten by the sacrificer (prāśitra, shall be taken) from the organ (of the animal); and the (other) portions shall be offered in water.'

2.1.s: api vāmāvāsyāyāṃ niśy agnim upasamādhāyadārvihomikīṃ pariceṣṭāṃ kṛtvā dve ājyāhutī juhoti | kāmāvakīrṇo 'smy avakīrṇo 'smi kāma kāmāya svāhā | kāmābhidrugdho 'smy abhidrugdho 'smi kāma kāmāya svāheti |
2.1.d: अपि वामावास्यायां निश्य् अग्निम् उपसमाधायदार्विहोमिकीं परिचेष्टां कृत्वा द्वे आज्याहुती जुहोति । कामावकीर्णो ऽस्म्य् अवकीर्णो ऽस्मि काम कामाय स्वाहा । कामाभिद्रुग्धो ऽस्म्य् अभिद्रुग्धो ऽस्मि काम कामाय स्वाहेति ।
2.1.e: 'Or he may also heap (fuel) on the fire in the night of the new moon, perform the preparatory rites required for the Darvīhoma, and offer two oblations of clarified butter (reciting these two sacred texts): "O Lust, I have broken my vow; my vow have I broken, O Lust; to Lust Svāhā;" "O Lust, I have done evil; evil have I done, O Lust; to Lust Svāhā."'

2.1.s: hutvā prayatāñjaliḥ kavātiryaṅṅ agnim abhimantrayeta | saṃ mā siñcantu marutaḥ sam indraḥ saṃ bṛhaspatiḥ | saṃmāyam agniḥ siñcatv āyuṣā ca balena cāyuṣmantaṃ karota meti |
2.1.d: हुत्वा प्रयताञ्जलिः कवातिर्यङ्ङ् अग्निम् अभिमन्त्रयेत । सं मा सिञ्चन्तु मरुतः सम् इन्द्रः सं बृहस्पतिः । संमायम् अग्निः सिञ्चत्व् आयुषा च बलेन चायुष्मन्तं करोत मेति ।
2.1.e: 'After he has made the offering, he shall address the fire, closely joining his hands, turning sideways (with the following texts): "May the Maruts grant me, may Indra, may B ri haspati, may this fire grant me long life and strength, may it make me long-lived! "'

2.1.s: athāsya jñātayaḥ pariṣady udapātraṃ ninayeyur asāv aham itthaṃbhūta iti | caritvāpaḥ payo ghṛtaṃ madhulavaṇam ity ārabdhavantaṃ brāhmaṇā brūyuś caritaṃ tvayeti | omitītaraḥ pratyāha | caritanirveśaṃ savanīyaṃ kuryuḥ |
2.1.d: अथास्य ज्ञातयः परिषद्य् उदपात्रं निनयेयुर् असाव् अहम् इत्थंभूत इति । चरित्वापः पयो घृतं मधुलवणम् इत्य् आरब्धवन्तं ब्राह्मणा ब्रूयुश् चरितं त्वयेति । ओमितीतरः प्रत्याह । चरितनिर्वेशं सवनीयं कुर्युः ।
2.1.e: Now the relatives shall empty (the water-pot) of a (grievous offender) at a (solemn) meeting (and he shall confess), 'I N. N. am (the perpetrator of) such and such (a deed).' After (the outcast) has performed (his penance) the Brāhmaṇas shall ask him who has touched water, milk, clarified butter, honey, and salt, 'Hast thou performed (thy penance)?' The other (person) shall answer, 'Om' (yes)! They shall admit him who has performed (a penance) to all sacrificial rites, making no difference (between him and others).

2.1.s: sagotrāṃ ced amatyopagacchen mātṛvad enāṃ bibhṛyāt |
2.1.d: सगोत्रां चेद् अमत्योपगच्छेन् मातृवद् एनां बिभृयात् ।
2.1.e: If he unintentionally marries a female who belongs to his own family (gotra), he shall support her, (treating her) like his mother.

2.1.s: prajātā cet kṛcchrābdapādaṃ caritvā | yan maātmano mindābhūt | punar agniś cakṣur adād iti | etābhyāṃ juhuyāt |
2.1.d: प्रजाता चेत् कृच्छ्राब्दपादं चरित्वा । यन् मआत्मनो मिन्दाभूत् । पुनर् अग्निश् चक्षुर् अदाद् इति । एताभ्यां जुहुयात् ।
2.1.e: If (such a woman) has borne a child; he shall perform K ri k kh ra penances during three months and offer (two burnt oblations reciting) the two (Mantras), 'That which is the blemish of my soul' (and) 'Fire restored my sight.'

2.1.s: parivittaḥ parivettā yā cainaṃ parivindati | sarve te narakaṃ yānti dātṛyājakapañcamāḥ |
2.1.d: परिवित्तः परिवेत्ता या चैनं परिविन्दति । सर्वे ते नरकं यान्ति दातृयाजकपञ्चमाः ।
2.1.e: 'An elder brother whose younger brother marries first, the younger brother who marries first, the damsel wedded (by the latter), he who gives her away, and fifthly, he who sacrifices for them (at the wedding), all sink to a region of torment.'

2.1.s: parivittaḥ parivettā dātā yaś cāpi yājakaḥ | kṛcchradvādaśarātreṇa strī trirātreṇa śudhyati || iti |
2.1.d: परिवित्तः परिवेत्ता दाता यश् चापि याजकः । कृच्छ्रद्वादशरात्रेण स्त्री त्रिरात्रेण शुध्यति ॥ इति ।
2.1.e: The unmarried elder brother and the married younger brother, the giver (of the maiden) and the performer of the sacrifices become pure by undergoing a K ri k kh ra penance of twelve days, the female (who has been wedded to the younger brother) by (fasting during) three days.'

2.1.s: atha patanīyāni |
2.1.d: अथ पतनीयानि ।
2.1.e: Now (follow the offences) causing loss of caste (patanīya),

2.1.s: samudrasaṃyānam |
2.1.d: समुद्रसंयानम् ।
2.1.e: (Viz.) making voyages by sea,

2.1.s: brahmasvanyāsāpaharaṇam |
2.1.d: ब्रह्मस्वन्यासापहरणम् ।
2.1.e: Stealing the property of a Brāhmaṇa or a deposit,

2.1.s: bhūmyanṛtam |
2.1.d: भूम्यनृतम् ।
2.1.e: Giving false evidence regarding land,

2.1.s: sarvapaṇyair vyavaharaṇam |
2.1.d: सर्वपण्यैर् व्यवहरणम् ।
2.1.e: Trading with merchandise of any description (whether forbidden or not),

2.1.s: śūdrasevanam |
2.1.d: शूद्रसेवनम् ।
2.1.e: Serving Śūdras,

2.1.s: śūdrābhijananam |
2.1.d: शूद्राभिजननम् ।
2.1.e: Begetting a son on a female of the Śūdra caste,

2.1.s: tadapatyatvaṃ ca |
2.1.d: तदपत्यत्वं च ।
2.1.e: And becoming thereby her son.

2.1.s: eteṣām anyatamaṃ kṛtvā |
2.1.d: एतेषाम् अन्यतमं कृत्वा ।
2.1.e: (For those who have) committed one of these (offences the following penance is prescribed);

2.1.s: caturthakālā mitabhojinaḥ syur apo 'bhyaveyuḥ savanānukalpam | sthānāsanābhyāṃ viharanta ete tribhir varṣais tad apaghnanti pāpam |
2.1.d: चतुर्थकाला मितभोजिनः स्युर् अपो ऽभ्यवेयुः सवनानुकल्पम् । स्थानासनाभ्यां विहरन्त एते त्रिभिर् वर्षैस् तद् अपघ्नन्ति पापम् ।
2.1.e: 'They shall eat every fourth meal-time a little food, bathe at the time of the three libations (morning, noon, and evening), passing (the day) standing and (the night) sitting. After the lapse of three years they throw off their guilt.'

2.1.s: yad ekarātreṇa karoti pāpaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ varṇaṃ brāhmaṇaḥsevamānaḥ | caturthakāla udakābhyavāyī tribhir varṣais tad apahantipāpam || iti |
2.1.d: यद् एकरात्रेण करोति पापं कृष्णं वर्णं ब्राह्मणःसेवमानः । चतुर्थकाल उदकाभ्यवायी त्रिभिर् वर्षैस् तद् अपहन्तिपापम् ॥ इति ।
2.1.e: 'A Brāhmaṇa removes the sin which he committed by serving the black race during one day and one night, if he bathes during three years at every fourth meal-time.'

2.1.s: athopapātakāni |
2.1.d: अथोपपातकानि ।
2.1.e: Now (follow) the minor offences, entailing loss of caste (upapātaka),

2.1.s: agamyāgamanaṃ gurvīsakhīṃ gurusakhīm apapātrāṃ patitāṃca gatvā bheṣajakaraṇaṃ grāmayājanaṃ raṅgopajīvanaṃnāṭyācāryatā gomahiṣīrakṣaṇaṃ yac cānyad apy evaṃyuktaṃkanyādūṣaṇam iti |
2.1.d: अगम्यागमनं गुर्वीसखीं गुरुसखीम् अपपात्रां पतितांच गत्वा भेषजकरणं ग्रामयाजनं रङ्गोपजीवनंनाट्याचार्यता गोमहिषीरक्षणं यच् चान्यद् अप्य् एवंयुक्तंकन्यादूषणम् इति ।
2.1.e: (Viz.) intercourse with females who must not be approached (agamyā, e.g.) cohabitation with the female friend of a female Guru, with the female friend of a male Guru, with an Apapātra woman, and a female outcast, following the profession of medicine, sacrificing for many, living by (performances on) the stage, following the profession of a teacher of dancing, singing and acting, tending cows and buffalos, and similar (low occupations, as well as) fornication.

2.1.s: teṣāṃ tu nirveśaḥ patitavṛttir dvau saṃvatsarau |
2.1.d: तेषां तु निर्वेशः पतितवृत्तिर् द्वौ संवत्सरौ ।
2.1.e: The expiation (prescribed) for these (offences is) to live as an outcast during two years.

2.1.s: athāśucikarāṇi |
2.1.d: अथाशुचिकराणि ।
2.1.e: Now (follow the offences) which make men impure (asu k ikara),

2.1.s: dyūtam abhicāro 'nāhitāgner uñchavṛttitā samāvṛttasyabhaikṣacaryā tasya caiva gurukule vāsa ūrdhvaṃ caturbhyo māsebhyastasya cādhyāpanaṃ nakṣatranirdeśaś ceti |
2.1.d: द्यूतम् अभिचारो ऽनाहिताग्नेर् उञ्छवृत्तिता समावृत्तस्यभैक्षचर्या तस्य चैव गुरुकुले वास ऊर्ध्वं चतुर्भ्यो मासेभ्यस्तस्य चाध्यापनं नक्षत्रनिर्देशश् चेति ।
2.1.e: (Viz.) gambling, performing incantations, subsisting by gleaning corn though one does not perform an Agnihotra, subsisting by alms after one has finished one's studentship, living, after that has been finished, longer than four months in the house of one's teacher, and teaching such a (person who has finished his studentship), gaining one's livelihood by astrology and so forth.

2.1.s: teṣāṃ tu nirveśo dvādaśa māsān dvādaśa ardhamāsāndvādaśa dvādaśāhān dvādaśa ṣaḍahān dvādaśa tryahān dvādaśāhaṃṣaḍahaṃ tryaham ahorātram ekāham iti yathā karmābhyāsaḥ |
2.1.d: तेषां तु निर्वेशो द्वादश मासान् द्वादश अर्धमासान्द्वादश द्वादशाहान् द्वादश षडहान् द्वादश त्र्यहान् द्वादशाहंषडहं त्र्यहम् अहोरात्रम् एकाहम् इति यथा कर्माभ्यासः ।
2.1.e: But the expiation of these (offences is to perform penances) during twelve months, during twelve fortnights, during twelve times ten days, during twelve se’nnights, during twelve times three days, during twelve days, during six days, during three days, during a day and a night, during one day, in proportion to the offence committed.

2.1.s: atha patitāḥ samavasāya dharmāṃś careyur itaretarayājakāitaretarādhyāpakā mitho vivahamānāḥ | putrān saṃniṣpādya brūyur vipravrajatāsmat ta evam āryān saṃpratipatsyatheti |
2.1.d: अथ पतिताः समवसाय धर्मांश् चरेयुर् इतरेतरयाजकाइतरेतराध्यापका मिथो विवहमानाः । पुत्रान् संनिष्पाद्य ब्रूयुर् विप्रव्रजतास्मत् त एवम् आर्यान् संप्रतिपत्स्यथेति ।
2.1.e: Now outcasts shall live together and (together) fulfil their duties, sacrificing for each other, teaching each other, and marrying amongst each other. If they have begot sons, they shall say to them, 'Depart from among us; thus you will again reach the Āryas.'

2.1.s: athāpi na sendriyaḥ patati |
2.1.d: अथापि न सेन्द्रियः पतति ।
2.1.e: For the organs do not become impure together with the man.

2.1.s: tad etena veditavyam | aṅgahīno 'pi sāṅgaṃ janayet |
2.1.d: तद् एतेन वेदितव्यम् । अङ्गहीनो ऽपि साङ्गं जनयेत् ।
2.1.e: (The truth of) that may be learned from this (parallel case); a man deficient in limbs begets a son who has the full number of limbs.

2.1.s: mithyaitad iti hārītaḥ |
2.1.d: मिथ्यैतद् इति हारीतः ।
2.1.e: Hārīta declares that this is wrong.

2.1.s: dadhidhānīsadharmāḥ striyaḥ syuḥ | yo hi dadhidhānyāmaprayataṃ paya ātacya manthati na tac chiṣṭā dharmakṛtyeṣūpayojayanti |
2.1.d: दधिधानीसधर्माः स्त्रियः स्युः । यो हि दधिधान्यामप्रयतं पय आतच्य मन्थति न तच् छिष्टा धर्मकृत्येषूपयोजयन्ति ।
2.1.e: For wives may be (considered) similar to the vessel which contains the curds (for the sacrifice). If one makes impure milk curdle in a milk-vessel and stirs it, the Śishṭas do not use the (curds thus produced) for sacred rites.

2.1.s: evam aśuci śukraṃ yan nirvartate na tena saha saṃprayogo vidyate |
2.1.d: एवम् अशुचि शुक्रं यन् निर्वर्तते न तेन सह संप्रयोगो विद्यते ।
2.1.e: In like manner no intercourse can be held with that (offspring) which is produced from impure seed.

2.1.s: aśuciśukrotpannānāṃ teṣām icchatāṃ prāyaścittiḥ |
2.1.d: अशुचिशुक्रोत्पन्नानां तेषाम् इच्छतां प्रायश्चित्तिः ।
2.1.e: If they desire it, (they may perform) a penance,

2.1.s: patanīyānāṃ tṛtīyo 'ṃśaḥ strīṇām aṃśas tṛtīyaḥ |
2.1.d: पतनीयानां तृतीयो ऽंशः स्त्रीणाम् अंशस् तृतीयः ।
2.1.e: (Viz. in the case of males) the third part (of the penance prescribed) for crimes causing loss of caste (patanīya); for females the third part (of that).

2.1.s: athāpy udāharanti | bhojanābhyañjanād dānād yad anyat kurute tilaiḥ | śvaviṣṭhāyāṃ kṛmir bhūtvā pitṛbhiḥ saha majjati || iti |
2.1.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । भोजनाभ्यञ्जनाद् दानाद् यद् अन्यत् कुरुते तिलैः । श्वविष्ठायां कृमिर् भूत्वा पितृभिः सह मज्जति ॥ इति ।
2.1.e: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'If he applies sesamum to any other purpose, but food, anointing, and charitable gifts, he will be born again as a worm and, together with his ancestors, be plunged into the ordure of dogs.'

2.1.s: pitqn vā eṣa vikrīṇīte yas tilān vikrīṇīte | prāṇānvā eṣa vikrīṇīte yas taṇḍulān vikrīṇīte | sukṛtāṃśān vā eṣa vikrīṇīte yaḥ paṇamāno duhitaraṃ dadāti |
2.1.d: पित्qन् वा एष विक्रीणीते यस् तिलान् विक्रीणीते । प्राणान्वा एष विक्रीणीते यस् तण्डुलान् विक्रीणीते । सुकृतांशान् वा एष विक्रीणीते यः पणमानो दुहितरं ददाति ।
2.1.e: He who sells sesamum, forsooth, sells his ancestors; he who sells rice, forsooth, sells his life; he who gives away his daughter, making a bargain, forsooth, sells portions of his spiritual merit.

2.1.s: tṛṇakāṣṭham avikṛtaṃ vikreyam |
2.1.d: तृणकाष्ठम् अविकृतं विक्रेयम् ।
2.1.e: Grass and wood, in its natural state, may be sold.

2.1.s: athāpy udāharanti | paśavaś caikatodantā aśmā ca lavaṇoddhṛtaḥ | etad brāhmaṇa te paṇyaṃ tantuś cārajanīkṛtaḥ || iti |
2.1.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । पशवश् चैकतोदन्ता अश्मा च लवणोद्धृतः । एतद् ब्राह्मण ते पण्यं तन्तुश् चारजनीकृतः ॥ इति ।
2.1.e: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'Animals that have teeth in one jaw only, as well as minerals excepting salt, and undyed thread, these, O Brāhmaṇa, are the goods which thou art permitted to sell.'

2.1.s: pātakavarjaṃ vā babhruṃ piṅgalāṃ gāṃ romaśāṃsarpiṣāvasicya kṛṣṇais tilair avakīryānūcānāya dadyāt |
2.1.d: पातकवर्जं वा बभ्रुं पिङ्गलां गां रोमशांसर्पिषावसिच्य कृष्णैस् तिलैर् अवकीर्यानूचानाय दद्यात् ।
2.1.e: (If he has committed) any offence excepting a mortal sin (pātaka) he may either give to a learned Brāhmaṇa (anū k āna) a hairy cow of brown or red-dish colour, after sprinkling her with clarified butter and scattering black sesamum seeds over her;

2.1.s: kūśmāṇḍair vā dvādaśāham |
2.1.d: कूश्माण्डैर् वा द्वादशाहम् ।
2.1.e: Or (he may offer burnt oblations), reciting the Kūshmāṇd as, during twelve days,

2.1.s: yad arvācīnam eno bhrūṇahatyāyās tasmān mucyata iti |
2.1.d: यद् अर्वाचीनम् एनो भ्रूणहत्यायास् तस्मान् मुच्यत इति ।
2.1.e: '(Thus) he will be freed. from the guilt (of any crime that is) less (heinous) than the murder of a learned Brāhmaṇa.'

2.1.s: pātakābhiśaṃsane kṛcchraḥ |
2.1.d: पातकाभिशंसने कृच्छ्रः ।
2.1.e: If one is accused of a mortal sin (pātaka), a K ri k kh ra (penance must be performed by the accused).

2.1.s: tadabdo 'bhiśaṃsituḥ |
2.1.d: तदब्दो ऽभिशंसितुः ।
2.1.e: The accuser (shall perform) that (K ri k kh ra penance during) a year.

2.1.s: saṃvatsareṇa patati patitena samācaran | yājanādhyāpanādyaunān na tu yānāsanāśanād iti |
2.1.d: संवत्सरेण पतति पतितेन समाचरन् । याजनाध्यापनाद्यौनान् न तु यानासनाशनाद् इति ।
2.1.e: 'He who during a year associates with an outcast, becomes (likewise) an outcast; not by sacrificing forḥim, by teaching him or by (forming) a matrimonial (alliance with him), but by using the same carriage or seat.'

2.1.s: amedhyaprāśane prāyaścittir naiṣpurīṣyam | tat saptarātreṇāvāpyate |
2.1.d: अमेध्यप्राशने प्रायश्चित्तिर् नैष्पुरीष्यम् । तत् सप्तरात्रेणावाप्यते ।
2.1.e: The penance for eating impure substances is to fast until the entrails are empty. That is attained in seven (days and) nights.

2.1.s: apaḥ payo ghṛtaṃ parāka iti pratitryaham uṣṇāni sataptakṛcchraḥ |
2.1.d: अपः पयो घृतं पराक इति प्रतित्र्यहम् उष्णानि सतप्तकृच्छ्रः ।
2.1.e: (Subsisting on) water, milk, clarified butter, (and) fasting,--each for three days,--(and taking the three fluids) hot, that is a Taptak ri k kh ra penance.

2.1.s: tryahaṃ prātas tathā sāyam ayācitaṃ parāka iti kṛcchraḥ |
2.1.d: त्र्यहं प्रातस् तथा सायम् अयाचितं पराक इति कृच्छ्रः ।
2.1.e: (Eating) during three days in the morning only, during the (next) three days in the evening only, (subsisting) during (another) three days (on) food given unasked, and fasting during three days, (that is) a K ri k kh ra penance.

2.1.s: prātaḥ sāyam ayācitaṃ parāka iti trayaś catūrātrāḥ sa eṣastrībālavṛddhānāṃ kṛcchraḥ |
2.1.d: प्रातः सायम् अयाचितं पराक इति त्रयश् चतूरात्राः स एषस्त्रीबालवृद्धानां कृच्छ्रः ।
2.1.e: (If the period of twelve days is divided into) three (periods of) four days, that is the K ri k kh ra penance of, women, children, and aged men.

2.1.s: yāvat sakṛd ādadīta tāvad aśnīyāt pūrvavat so 'tikṛcchraḥ |
2.1.d: यावत् सकृद् आददीत तावद् अश्नीयात् पूर्ववत् सो ऽतिकृच्छ्रः ।
2.1.e: If (observing the rule given) above one eats (at each meal) so much only as one can take at one (mouthful), that is an Atik ri k kh ra penance.

2.1.s: abbhakṣas tṛtīyaḥ sa kṛcchrātikṛcchraḥ |
2.1.d: अब्भक्षस् तृतीयः स कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रः ।
2.1.e: (If one) subsists on water only, that is a K ri k kh rātik ri k kh ra, the third (in the order of the K ri k kh ra penances).

2.1.s: kṛcchre triṣavaṇam udakopasparśanam |
2.1.d: कृच्छ्रे त्रिषवणम् उदकोपस्पर्शनम् ।
2.1.e: During a K ri k kh ra penance (the following rules must be followed, viz.) to bathe at morn, noon, and evening,

2.1.s: adhaḥśayanam |
2.1.d: अधःशयनम् ।
2.1.e: To sleep on the ground,

2.1.s: ekavastratā keśaśmaśrulomanakhavāpanam |
2.1.d: एकवस्त्रता केशश्मश्रुलोमनखवापनम् ।
2.1.e: To wear one garment only, to shave the hair of the head, of the beard, and of the body, and to clip the nails.

2.1.s: etad eva striyāḥ keśavapanavarjam | keśavapanavarjam |
2.1.d: एतद् एव स्त्रियाः केशवपनवर्जम् । केशवपनवर्जम् ।
2.1.e: The same (rules apply) to women except (that referring to) shaving the head.

2.2.s: nityodakī nityayajñopavītī nityasvādhyāyīvṛṣalānnavarjī | ṛtau ca gacchan vidhivac ca juhvan na brāhmaṇaś cyavatebrahmalokāt |
2.2.d: नित्योदकी नित्ययज्ञोपवीती नित्यस्वाध्यायीवृषलान्नवर्जी । ऋतौ च गच्छन् विधिवच् च जुह्वन् न ब्राह्मणश् च्यवतेब्रह्मलोकात् ।
2.2.e: A Brāhmaṇa who always carries water (in his pot), who always wears the sacred thread, who daily recites the Veda, who avoids the food of Śūdras, who approaches (his wife) in the proper season, and offers sacrifices in accordance with the rules (of the Veda, after death) never falls from Brahman's heaven.

2.2.s: manuḥ putrebhyo dāyaṃ vyabhajad iti śrutiḥ |
2.2.d: मनुः पुत्रेभ्यो दायं व्यभजद् इति श्रुतिः ।
2.2.e: The Veda (says), 'Manu divided his estate among his sons.'

2.2.s: samaśaḥ sarveṣām aviśeṣāt |
2.2.d: समशः सर्वेषाम् अविशेषात् ।
2.2.e: (A father may, therefore, divide his property) equally among all, without (making any) difference;

2.2.s: varaṃ vā rūpam uddharej jyeṣṭhaḥ |
2.2.d: वरं वा रूपम् उद्धरेज् ज्येष्ठः ।
2.2.e: Or the eldest may receive the most excellent chattel.

2.2.s: tasmāj jyeṣṭhaṃ putraṃ dhanena niravasāyayantīti śrutiḥ |
2.2.d: तस्माज् ज्येष्ठं पुत्रं धनेन निरवसाययन्तीति श्रुतिः ।
2.2.e: (For) the Veda says, 'Therefore, they distinguish the eldest by (an additional share of the) property.

2.2.s: daśānāṃ vaikam uddharej jyeṣṭhaḥ |
2.2.d: दशानां वैकम् उद्धरेज् ज्येष्ठः ।
2.2.e: Or the eldest may receive (in excess) one part out of ten;

2.2.s: samam itare vibhajeran |
2.2.d: समम् इतरे विभजेरन् ।
2.2.e: (And) the other (sons) shall receive equal shares.

2.2.s: pitur anumatyā dāyavibhāgaḥ sati pitari |
2.2.d: पितुर् अनुमत्या दायविभागः सति पितरि ।
2.2.e: While the father lives, the division of the estate takes place (only) with the permission of the father.

2.2.s: caturṇāṃ varṇānāṃ go 'śvājāvayo jyeṣṭhāṃśaḥ |
2.2.d: चतुर्णां वर्णानां गो ऽश्वाजावयो ज्येष्ठांशः ।
2.2.e: The (additional) share of the eldest is, (according to the order) of the four castes, a cow, a horse, a goat, and a sheep.

2.2.s: nānāvarṇastrīputrasamavāye dāyaṃ daśāṃśān kṛtvācaturas trīn dvāv ekam iti yathākramaṃ vibhajeran |
2.2.d: नानावर्णस्त्रीपुत्रसमवाये दायं दशांशान् कृत्वाचतुरस् त्रीन् द्वाव् एकम् इति यथाक्रमं विभजेरन् ।
2.2.e: If there are sons born of wives of different castes (varṇa), they should make ten portions of the ancestral property and take four (shares), three, two, (and) one, according to the order (of the castes).

2.2.s: aurase tūtpanne savarṇās tṛtīyāṃśaharāḥ |
2.2.d: औरसे तूत्पन्ने सवर्णास् तृतीयांशहराः ।
2.2.e: But if a legitimate son of the body (aurasa) is born, the (other) sons of equal caste shall obtain one third share (of the estate).

2.2.s: savarṇāputrānantarāputrayor anantarāputraś ced guṇavānsa jyeṣṭhāṃśaṃ haret |
2.2.d: सवर्णापुत्रानन्तरापुत्रयोर् अनन्तरापुत्रश् चेद् गुणवान्स ज्येष्ठांशं हरेत् ।
2.2.e: If there is a son of equal caste and a son of a wife of the next lower caste, the son born of the wife of the next lower caste may take the share of the eldest, provided he be endowed with good qualities.

2.2.s: guṇavān hi śeṣāṇāṃ bhartā bhavati |
2.2.d: गुणवान् हि शेषाणां भर्ता भवति ।
2.2.e: (A son) who possesses good qualities becomes the protector of the rest.

2.2.s: savarṇāyāṃ saṃskṛtāyāṃ svayamutpāditam aurasaṃ putraṃ vidyāt | athāpy udāharanti | aṅgād aṅgāt saṃbhavasi hṛdayād adhi jāyase | ātmā vai putranāmāsi sa jīva śaradaḥ śatam || iti |
2.2.d: सवर्णायां संस्कृतायां स्वयमुत्पादितम् औरसं पुत्रं विद्यात् । अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अङ्गाद् अङ्गात् संभवसि हृदयाद् अधि जायसे । आत्मा वै पुत्रनामासि स जीव शरदः शतम् ॥ इति ।
2.2.e: One must know a son begotten by (the husband) himself on a wedded wife of equal caste (to be) a legitimate son of the body (aurasa). Now they quote also (the following verse): 'From the several limbs (of my body) art thou produced, from my heart art thou born; thou art "self" called a son; mayest thou live a hundred autumns.'

2.2.s: abhyupagamya duhitari jātaṃ putrikāputram anyaṃ dauhitram |
2.2.d: अभ्युपगम्य दुहितरि जातं पुत्रिकापुत्रम् अन्यं दौहित्रम् ।
2.2.e: The (male child) born of a daughter, after an agreement has been made, (one must know to be) the son of an appointed daughter (putrikāputra); any other (male offspring of a daughter they call) a daughter's son (dauhitra).

2.2.s: athāpy udāharanti | ādiśet prathame piṇḍe mātaraṃ putrikāsutaḥ | dvitīye pitaraṃ tasyās tṛtīye ca pitāmaham || iti |
2.2.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । आदिशेत् प्रथमे पिण्डे मातरं पुत्रिकासुतः । द्वितीये पितरं तस्यास् तृतीये च पितामहम् ॥ इति ।
2.2.e: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'The son of an appointed daughter should offer the first funeral cake to his mother, the second to her father, and the third to his father's father.'

2.2.s: mṛtasya prasūto yaḥ klībavyādhitayor vānyenānumate sve kṣetre sa kṣetrajaḥ |
2.2.d: मृतस्य प्रसूतो यः क्लीबव्याधितयोर् वान्येनानुमते स्वे क्षेत्रे स क्षेत्रजः ।
2.2.e: He who is begotten, by another man, on the wife of a deceased man, of a eunuch, or of one (incurably) diseased, after permission (has been given), is called the son begotten on a wife (kshetra g a).

2.2.s: sa eṣa dvipitā dvigotraś ca dvayor api svadhārikthabhāg bhavati |
2.2.d: स एष द्विपिता द्विगोत्रश् च द्वयोर् अपि स्वधारिक्थभाग् भवति ।
2.2.e: Such a (son begotten on a wife) has two fathers and belongs to two families; he has a right to perform the funeral oblations, and to inherit the property of (his) two (fathers).

2.2.s: athāpy udāharanti | dvipituḥ piṇḍadānaṃ syāt piṇḍepiṇḍe ca nāmanī | trayaś ca piṇḍāḥ ṣaṇṇāṃ syur evaṃ kurvan na muhyati || iti |
2.2.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । द्विपितुः पिण्डदानं स्यात् पिण्डेपिण्डे च नामनी । त्रयश् च पिण्डाः षण्णां स्युर् एवं कुर्वन् न मुह्यति ॥ इति ।
2.2.e: Now they quote also (the following verse): The son of two fathers shall give the funeral cakes (to his two fathers, and pronounce) two names with each oblation, and three cakes shall serve for six persons; he who acts thus will not err.'

2.2.s: mātāpitṛbhyāṃ datto 'nyatareṇa vā yo 'patyārthe parigṛhyate sa dattaḥ |
2.2.d: मातापितृभ्यां दत्तो ऽन्यतरेण वा यो ऽपत्यार्थे परिगृह्यते स दत्तः ।
2.2.e: He (is called) an adopted son (datta) who, being given by his father and his mother, or by either of the two, is received in the place of a child.

2.2.s: sadṛśaṃ yaṃ sakāmaṃ svayaṃ kuryāt sa kṛtrimaḥ |
2.2.d: सदृशं यं सकामं स्वयं कुर्यात् स कृत्रिमः ।
2.2.e: He (is called) a son made (k ri trima) whom (a mail) himself makes (his son), with the (adoptee's) consent (only), and who belongs to the same caste (as the adopter).

2.2.s: gṛhe gūḍhotpanno 'nte jñāto gūḍhajaḥ |
2.2.d: गृहे गूढोत्पन्नो ऽन्ते ज्ञातो गूढजः ।
2.2.e: He is called a son born secretly (gū dh agga) who is secretly born in the house and whose (origin is) afterwards (only) recognised.

2.2.s: mātāpitṛbhyām utsṛṣṭo 'nyatareṇa vā yo 'patyārthe parigṛhyate so 'paviddhaḥ |
2.2.d: मातापितृभ्याम् उत्सृष्टो ऽन्यतरेण वा यो ऽपत्यार्थे परिगृह्यते सो ऽपविद्धः ।
2.2.e: He is called a son cast off (apaviddha) who, being, cast off by his father and his mother, or by either (of them), is received in the place of a child.

2.2.s: asaṃskṛtām anatisṛṣṭāṃ yām upagacchet tasyāṃ yo jātaḥ sa kānīnaḥ |
2.2.d: असंस्कृताम् अनतिसृष्टां याम् उपगच्छेत् तस्यां यो जातः स कानीनः ।
2.2.e: If anybody approaches an unmarried girl without the permission (of her father or guardian), the son born by such (a woman is called) the son of an unmarried damsel (kānīna).

2.2.s: yā garbhiṇī saṃskriyate vijñātā vāvijñātā vā tasyāṃyo jātaḥ sa sahoḍhaḥ |
2.2.d: या गर्भिणी संस्क्रियते विज्ञाता वाविज्ञाता वा तस्यांयो जातः स सहोढः ।
2.2.e: If one marries either knowingly or unknowingly a pregnant bride, the child which is born of her is called (a son) taken with the bride (saho dh a).

2.2.s: mātāpitror hastāt krīto 'nyatareṇa vā yo 'patyārthe parigṛhyate sa krītaḥ |
2.2.d: मातापित्रोर् हस्तात् क्रीतो ऽन्यतरेण वा यो ऽपत्यार्थे परिगृह्यते स क्रीतः ।
2.2.e: He (is called a son) bought (krīta) who, being purchased from his father and his mother, or from either of them, is received in the place of a child.

2.2.s: klībaṃ tyaktvā patitaṃ vā yānyaṃ patiṃ vindet tasyāṃpunarbhvāṃ yo jātaḥ sa paunarbhavaḥ |
2.2.d: क्लीबं त्यक्त्वा पतितं वा यान्यं पतिं विन्देत् तस्यांपुनर्भ्वां यो जातः स पौनर्भवः ।
2.2.e: He (is called the son) of a twice-married woman (paunarbhava) who is born of a re-married female, (i.e.) of one who, having left an impotent man, has taken a second husband.

2.2.s: mātāpitṛvihīno yaḥ svayam ātmānaṃ dadyāt sa svayaṃdattaḥ |
2.2.d: मातापितृविहीनो यः स्वयम् आत्मानं दद्यात् स स्वयंदत्तः ।
2.2.e: He (is called) a self-given (son, svayaṃdatta) who, abandoned by his father and his mother, gives himself (to a stranger).

2.2.s: dvijātipravarāc chūdrāyāṃ jāto niṣādaḥ |
2.2.d: द्विजातिप्रवराच् छूद्रायां जातो निषादः ।
2.2.e: He who is begotten by (a man of) the first twice-born (caste) on a female of the Śūdra caste (is called) a Nishāda.

2.2.s: kāmāt pāraśava iti putrāḥ |
2.2.d: कामात् पारशव इति पुत्राः ।
2.2.e: (He who was begotten by the same parents) through lust (is called) a Pāraśava. Thus (the various kinds of) sons (have been enumerated).

2.2.s: athāpy udāharanti | aurasaṃ putrikāputraṃ kṣetrajaṃ dattakṛtrimau | gūḍhajaṃ cāpaviddhaṃ ca rikthabhājaḥ pracakṣate |
2.2.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । औरसं पुत्रिकापुत्रं क्षेत्रजं दत्तकृत्रिमौ । गूढजं चापविद्धं च रिक्थभाजः प्रचक्षते ।
2.2.e: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'They declare the legitimate son, the son of an appointed daughter, the son begotten on a wife, the adopted son and the son made, the son born secretly and the son cast off, (to be entitled) to share the inheritance.'

2.2.s: kānīnaṃ ca sahoḍhaṃ ca krītaṃ paunarbhavaṃ tathā | svayaṃdattaṃ niṣādaṃ ca gotrabhājaḥ pracakṣate |
2.2.d: कानीनं च सहोढं च क्रीतं पौनर्भवं तथा । स्वयंदत्तं निषादं च गोत्रभाजः प्रचक्षते ।
2.2.e: 'They declare the son of an unmarried damsel and the son received with the bride, the son bought, likewise the son of a twice-married female, the son self-given and the Nishāda, to be members of the family.'

2.2.s: teṣāṃ prathama evety āhaupajaṅghaniḥ |
2.2.d: तेषां प्रथम एवेत्य् आहौपजङ्घनिः ।
2.2.e: Aupa g andhani (declares that) the first among them alone (is entitled to inherit, and a member of his father's family).

2.2.s: idānīm aham īrṣyāmi strīṇāṃ janaka no purā | yato yamasya sadane janayituḥ putram abruvan | retodhāḥ putraṃ nayati paretya yamasādane | tasmāt svabhāryāṃ rakṣantu bibhyataḥ pararetasaḥ |
2.2.d: इदानीम् अहम् ईर्ष्यामि स्त्रीणां जनक नो पुरा । यतो यमस्य सदने जनयितुः पुत्रम् अब्रुवन् । रेतोधाः पुत्रं नयति परेत्य यमसादने । तस्मात् स्वभार्यां रक्षन्तु बिभ्यतः पररेतसः ।
2.2.e: 'Now, O G anaka, I jealously watch my wives, (though I did) not (do it) formerly; for they have declared in Yama's court that the son belongs to the begetter. The giver of the seed carries off the son, after death, in Yama's hall, Therefore they carefully protect their wives, fearing the seed of strangers.'

2.2.s: apramattā rakṣata tantum etaṃ mā vaḥ kṣetreparabījāni vāpsuḥ | janayituḥ putro bhavati sāṃparāye moghaṃvettā kurute tantum etam || iti |
2.2.d: अप्रमत्ता रक्षत तन्तुम् एतं मा वः क्षेत्रेपरबीजानि वाप्सुः । जनयितुः पुत्रो भवति सांपराये मोघंवेत्ता कुरुते तन्तुम् एतम् ॥ इति ।
2.2.e: 'Carefully watch (the procreation of your) offspring, lest strange seed fall on your soil. After death the son belongs to the begetter; through carelessness a husband makes (the procreation of) a son useless.'

2.2.s: teṣām aprāptavyavahārāṇām aṃśān sopacayān suniguptān nidadhyur ā vyavahāraprāpaṇāt |
2.2.d: तेषाम् अप्राप्तव्यवहाराणाम् अंशान् सोपचयान् सुनिगुप्तान् निदध्युर् आ व्यवहारप्रापणात् ।
2.2.e: Let them carefully protect the shares of those who are minors, as well as the increments (thereon).

2.2.s: atītavyavahārān grāsācchādanair bibhṛyuḥ |
2.2.d: अतीतव्यवहारान् ग्रासाच्छादनैर् बिभृयुः ।
2.2.e: Granting food, clothes, (and shelter), they shall support those who are incapable of transacting legal business,

2.2.s: andhajaḍaklībavyasanivyādhitādīṃś ca |
2.2.d: अन्धजडक्लीबव्यसनिव्याधितादींश् च ।
2.2.e: (Viz.) the blind, idiots, those immersed in vice, the incurably diseased, and so forth,

2.2.s: akarmiṇaḥ |
2.2.d: अकर्मिणः ।
2.2.e: Those who neglect their duties and occupations;

2.2.s: patitatajjātavarjam |
2.2.d: पतिततज्जातवर्जम् ।
2.2.e: But not the outcast nor his offspring.

2.2.s: na patitaiḥ saṃvyavahāro vidyate |
2.2.d: न पतितैः संव्यवहारो विद्यते ।
2.2.e: Intercourse with outcasts shall not take place.

2.2.s: patitām api tu mātaraṃ bibhṛyād anabhibhāṣamāṇaḥ |
2.2.d: पतिताम् अपि तु मातरं बिभृयाद् अनभिभाषमाणः ।
2.2.e: But he shall support an outcast mother, without speaking to her.

2.2.s: mātur alaṃkāraṃ duhitaraḥ sāṃpradāyikaṃ labherann anyad vā |
2.2.d: मातुर् अलंकारं दुहितरः सांप्रदायिकं लभेरन्न् अन्यद् वा ।
2.2.e: The daughters shall obtain the ornaments of their mother, (as many as are) presented according to the custom (of the caste), or anything else (that may be given according to custom).

2.2.s: na striyāḥ svātantryaṃ vidyate |
2.2.d: न स्त्रियाः स्वातन्त्र्यं विद्यते ।
2.2.e: Women do not possess independence.

2.2.s: athāpy udāharanti | pitā rakṣati kaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane | putras tu sthavirībhāve na strīsvātantryam arhati || iti |
2.2.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । पिता रक्षति कौमारे भर्ता रक्षति यौवने । पुत्रस् तु स्थविरीभावे न स्त्रीस्वातन्त्र्यम् अर्हति ॥ इति ।
2.2.e: Now they quote also (the following verse): Their father protects (them) in childhood, their husband protects (them) in youth, and their sons protect (them) in old age a woman is never fit for independence.'

2.2.s: nirindriyā hy adāyāś ca striyo matā iti śrutiḥ |
2.2.d: निरिन्द्रिया ह्य् अदायाश् च स्त्रियो मता इति श्रुतिः ।
2.2.e: The Veda declares, 'Therefore women are considered to be destitute of strength and of a portion.'

2.2.s: bhartṛhite yatamānāḥ svargaṃ lokaṃ jayeran |
2.2.d: भर्तृहिते यतमानाः स्वर्गं लोकं जयेरन् ।
2.2.e: Those (women) who strive (to do what is) agreeable to their husbands will gain heaven.

2.2.s: vyatikrame kṛcchraḥ |
2.2.d: व्यतिक्रमे कृच्छ्रः ।
2.2.e: But for a violation (of their duty towards the husband) a K ri k kh ra penance (must be performed).

2.2.s: śūdre cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret |
2.2.d: शूद्रे चान्द्रायणं चरेत् ।
2.2.e: (For violating it) with a Śūdra (a woman) shall perform a lunar penance ( k āndrāyaṇa);

2.2.s: vaiśyādiṣu pratilomaṃ kṛcchrātikṛcchrādīṃś caret |
2.2.d: वैश्यादिषु प्रतिलोमं कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रादींश् चरेत् ।
2.2.e: (For violating it) against the order of the castes with a Vaiśya and so forth, she shall perform a K ri k kh ra or an (Atik ri k kh ra) penance.

2.2.s: puṃsāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ saṃvatsaraṃ brahmacaryam |
2.2.d: पुंसां ब्राह्मणादीनां संवत्सरं ब्रह्मचर्यम् ।
2.2.e: For male (offenders, i.e.) Brāhmaṇas and so forth, a year's chastity (is prescribed).

2.2.s: śūdraṃ kaṭāgninā dahet |
2.2.d: शूद्रं कटाग्निना दहेत् ।
2.2.e: Let him burn a Śūdra (who commits adultery with an Āryan) in a straw-fire.

2.2.s: athāpy udāharanti |
2.2.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति ।
2.2.e: Now they quote also (the following verses):

2.2.s: abrāhmaṇasya śārīro daṇḍaḥ saṃgrahaṇe bhavet |
2.2.d: अब्राह्मणस्य शारीरो दण्डः संग्रहणे भवेत् ।
2.2.e: 'Anybody but a Brāhmaṇa shall suffer corporal punishment for adultery.'

2.2.s: sarveṣām eva varṇānāṃ dārā rakṣyatamā dhanāt |
2.2.d: सर्वेषाम् एव वर्णानां दारा रक्ष्यतमा धनात् ।
2.2.e: 'The wives (of men) of all castes must be guarded more carefully than wealth.'

2.2.s: na tu cāraṇadāreṣu na raṅgāvatare vadhaḥ | saṃsarjayanti tā hy etān niguptāṃś cālayanty api |
2.2.d: न तु चारणदारेषु न रङ्गावतरे वधः । संसर्जयन्ति ता ह्य् एतान् निगुप्तांश् चालयन्त्य् अपि ।
2.2.e: 'But corporal punishment (shall) not (be inflicted) for (adultery with) the wives of minstrels and with those who appear on the stage. For (the husbands) carry them (to other men), or, lying concealed (at home), permit them to hold culpable intercourse.'

2.2.s: striyaḥ pavitram atulaṃ naitā duṣyanti karhicit | māsimāsi rajo hy āsāṃ duritāny apakarṣati |
2.2.d: स्त्रियः पवित्रम् अतुलं नैता दुष्यन्ति कर्हिचित् । मासिमासि रजो ह्य् आसां दुरितान्य् अपकर्षति ।
2.2.e: 'Women (possess) an unrivalled means of purification; they never become (entirely) foul. For month by month their temporary uncleanness removes their sins.'

2.2.s: somaḥ śaucaṃ dadau tāsāṃ gandharvaḥ śikṣitāṃ giram | agniś ca sarvabhakṣatvaṃ tasmānniṣkalmaṣāḥ striyaḥ |
2.2.d: सोमः शौचं ददौ तासां गन्धर्वः शिक्षितां गिरम् । अग्निश् च सर्वभक्षत्वं तस्मान्निष्कल्मषाः स्त्रियः ।
2.2.e: 'Soma gave them cleanliness, the Gandharva their melodious voice, and Fire purity of all (limbs); therefore women are free from stains.'

2.2.s: aprajāṃ daśame varṣe strīprajāṃ dvādaśe tyajet | mṛtaprajāṃ pañcadaśe sadyas tv apriyavādinīm |
2.2.d: अप्रजां दशमे वर्षे स्त्रीप्रजां द्वादशे त्यजेत् । मृतप्रजां पञ्चदशे सद्यस् त्व् अप्रियवादिनीम् ।
2.2.e: 'Let him abandon a barren (wife) in the tenth year, one who bears daughters (only) in the twelfth, one whose children (all) die in the fifteenth, but her who is quarrelsome without delay.'

2.2.s: saṃvatsaraṃ pretapatnī madhumāṃsamadyalavaṇāni varjayedadhaḥ śayīta |
2.2.d: संवत्सरं प्रेतपत्नी मधुमांसमद्यलवणानि वर्जयेदधः शयीत ।
2.2.e: A widow shall avoid during a year (the use of) honey, meat, spirituous liquor, and salt, and sleep on the ground.

2.2.s: ṣaṇmāsān iti maudgalyaḥ |
2.2.d: षण्मासान् इति मौद्गल्यः ।
2.2.e: Maudgalya (declares that she shall do so) during six months.

2.2.s: ata ūrdhvaṃ gurubhir anumatā devarāj janayet putram aputrā |
2.2.d: अत ऊर्ध्वं गुरुभिर् अनुमता देवराज् जनयेत् पुत्रम् अपुत्रा ।
2.2.e: After (the expiration of) that (time) she may, with the permission of her Gurus, bear a son to her brother-in-law, in case she has no son.

2.2.s: athāpy udāharanti | vaśā cotpannaputrā ca nīrajaskā gataprajā | nākāmā saṃniyojyā syāt phalaṃ yasyāṃ na vidyate || iti |
2.2.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । वशा चोत्पन्नपुत्रा च नीरजस्का गतप्रजा । नाकामा संनियोज्या स्यात् फलं यस्यां न विद्यते ॥ इति ।
2.2.e: Now they quote also (the following verse): One whose appointment can have no result, (viz.) a barren woman, one who has borne sons, one who is past child-bearing, one whose children are (all) dead, and one who is unwilling must not be appointed.'

2.2.s: mātulapitṛsvasā bhaginī bhāgineyī snuṣā mātulānīsakhivadhūr ity agamyāḥ |
2.2.d: मातुलपितृस्वसा भगिनी भागिनेयी स्नुषा मातुलानीसखिवधूर् इत्य् अगम्याः ।
2.2.e: The sister of a maternal uncle and of the father, a sister, a sister's daughter, a daughter-in-law, a maternal uncle's wife, and the wife of a friend are females who must never be approached (agamyā).

2.2.s: agamyānāṃ gamane kṛcchrātikṛcchrau cāndrāyaṇam itiprāyaścittiḥ |
2.2.d: अगम्यानां गमने कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रौ चान्द्रायणम् इतिप्रायश्चित्तिः ।
2.2.e: For intercourse with females who must not be approached (agamyā), a K ri k kh ra and an Atik ri k kh ra (and) a K āndrāyaṇa are the penances prescribed for all.

2.2.s: etena caṇḍālīvyavāyo vyākhyātaḥ |
2.2.d: एतेन चण्डालीव्यवायो व्याख्यातः ।
2.2.e: Thereby (the rule regarding) intercourse with a female of the K aṇd āla caste has been declared.

2.2.s: athāpy udāharanti | caṇḍālīṃ brāhmaṇo gatvā bhuktvā ca pratigṛhya ca | ajñānāt patito vipro jñānāt tu samatāṃ vrajet |
2.2.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । चण्डालीं ब्राह्मणो गत्वा भुक्त्वा च प्रतिगृह्य च । अज्ञानात् पतितो विप्रो ज्ञानात् तु समतां व्रजेत् ।
2.2.e: Now they quote also (the following verses): A Brāhmaṇa who unintentionally approaches a female of the K aṇd āla caste, eats (food given by a K aṇd āla) or receives (presents from him), becomes an outcast; but (if he does it) intentionally, he becomes equal (to a K aṇd āla).

2.2.s: pitur guror narendrasya bhāryāṃ gatvā pramādataḥ | gurutalpī bhavet tena pūrvoktas tasya niṣkrayaḥ || iti |
2.2.d: पितुर् गुरोर् नरेन्द्रस्य भार्यां गत्वा प्रमादतः । गुरुतल्पी भवेत् तेन पूर्वोक्तस् तस्य निष्क्रयः ॥ इति ।
2.2.e: 'He who approaches his father's, his teacher's, or a king's wife, is guilty of the crime of violating a Guru's bed; the penance ordained for him has been declared above.'

2.2.s: adhyāpanayājanapratigrahair aśaktaḥ kṣatradharmeṇa jīvetpratyanantaratvāt |
2.2.d: अध्यापनयाजनप्रतिग्रहैर् अशक्तः क्षत्रधर्मेण जीवेत्प्रत्यनन्तरत्वात् ।
2.2.e: (A Brāhmaṇa) who is unable (to subsist) by teaching, sacrificing for others, or the acceptance of gifts, shall maintain himself by following the duties of Kshatriyas, because that is the next following (caste).

2.2.s: neti gautamaḥ | atyugro hi kṣatradharmo brāhmaṇasya |
2.2.d: नेति गौतमः । अत्युग्रो हि क्षत्रधर्मो ब्राह्मणस्य ।
2.2.e: Gautama (declares that one shall) not (act thus). For the duties of Kshatriyas are too cruel for a Brāhmaṇa.

2.2.s: athāpy udāharanti | gavārthe brāhmaṇārthe vā varṇānāṃ vāpi saṃkare | gṛhṇīyātāṃ vipraviśau śastraṃ dharmavyapekṣayā |
2.2.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । गवार्थे ब्राह्मणार्थे वा वर्णानां वापि संकरे । गृह्णीयातां विप्रविशौ शस्त्रं धर्मव्यपेक्षया ।
2.2.e: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'Out of regard for the sacred law a Brāhmaṇa and a Vaiśya may take up arms for (the protection of) cows or Brāhmaṇas, or when a confusion of the castes (threatens to take place).

2.2.s: vaiśyavṛttir anuṣṭheyā pratyanantaratvāt |
2.2.d: वैश्यवृत्तिर् अनुष्ठेया प्रत्यनन्तरत्वात् ।
2.2.e: (Or) the livelihood of a Vaiśya should be adopted, because that is the one following (next):

2.2.s: prāk prātarāśāt karṣī syāt |
2.2.d: प्राक् प्रातराशात् कर्षी स्यात् ।
2.2.e: (If he lives by agriculture) he shall plough before breakfast,

2.2.s: asyūtanāsikābhyāṃ samuṣkābhyām atudann ārayāmuhurmuhur abhyucchandayan |
2.2.d: अस्यूतनासिकाभ्यां समुष्काभ्याम् अतुदन्न् आरयामुहुर्मुहुर् अभ्युच्छन्दयन् ।
2.2.e: With two bulls whose noses have not been pierced, not striking them with the goad, (but) frequently coaxing them.

2.2.s: bhāryādir agniḥ | tasmin karmakaraṇaṃ prāg agnyādheyāt |
2.2.d: भार्यादिर् अग्निः । तस्मिन् कर्मकरणं प्राग् अग्न्याधेयात् ।
2.2.e: The (sacred domestic) fire (shall be kindled) at the wedding; the religious ceremonies up to the Agnyādheya (shall be) performed in that.

2.2.s: agnyādheyaprabhṛty athemāny ajasrāṇi bhavanti yathaitadagnyādheyam agnihotraṃ darśapūrṇamāsāv āgrayaṇamudagayanadakṣiṇāyanayoḥ paśuś cāturmāsyāny ṛtumukhe ṣaḍḍhotā vasantejyotiṣtoma ity evaṃ kṣemaprāpaṇam |
2.2.d: अग्न्याधेयप्रभृत्य् अथेमान्य् अजस्राणि भवन्ति यथैतदग्न्याधेयम् अग्निहोत्रं दर्शपूर्णमासाव् आग्रयणमुदगयनदक्षिणायनयोः पशुश् चातुर्मास्यान्य् ऋतुमुखे षड्ढोता वसन्तेज्योतिष्तोम इत्य् एवं क्षेमप्रापणम् ।
2.2.e: Now, beginning with the Agnyādheya, follow these (rites in an) uninterrupted (series), as, for instance, the Agnyādheya, the Agnihotra, the new and full moon sacrifices, the Āgraya.a at the winter and summer solstices, the animal sacrifice, the K āturmāsyas at the beginning of each season, the Shaḍdh ot ri in spring, the Agnishṭoma. Thus the attainment of bliss (is secured).

2.2.s: athāpy udāharanti | na divāsvapnaśīlena na ca sarvānnabhojinā | kāmaṃ śakyaṃ nabho gantum ārūḍhapatitena vā |
2.2.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । न दिवास्वप्नशीलेन न च सर्वान्नभोजिना । कामं शक्यं नभो गन्तुम् आरूढपतितेन वा ।
2.2.e: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'Neither he who is accustomed to sleep in the day-time, nor he who eats the food of anybody, nor he who falls from a height to which he has climbed, can reach heaven as he desires.'

2.2.s: dainyaṃ śāṭhyaṃ jaihmyaṃ ca varjayet |
2.2.d: दैन्यं शाठ्यं जैह्म्यं च वर्जयेत् ।
2.2.e: Let him avoid meanness, hard-heartedness, and crookedness.

2.2.s: athāpy atrośanasaś ca vṛṣaparvaṇaś ca duhitroḥ saṃvādegāthām udāharanti | stuvato duhitā tvaṃ vai yācataḥ pratigṛhṇataḥ | athāhaṃ stūyamānasya dadato 'pratigṛhṇataḥ | dadato 'pratigṛhṇata iti |
2.2.d: अथाप्य् अत्रोशनसश् च वृषपर्वणश् च दुहित्रोः संवादेगाथाम् उदाहरन्ति । स्तुवतो दुहिता त्वं वै याचतः प्रतिगृह्णतः । अथाहं स्तूयमानस्य ददतो ऽप्रतिगृह्णतः । ददतो ऽप्रतिगृह्णत इति ।
2.2.e: Now they quote also with reference to this (subject the following) verse in the dialogue between the daughters of Uśanas and V ri shaparvan: 'Thou, forsooth, art the daughter of one who praises (others), who begs and accepts (gifts); but I am the child of one who is praised, who gives gifts and does not accept them.'

2.3.s: tapasyam apovagāhanam |
2.3.d: तपस्यम् अपोवगाहनम् ।
2.3.e: Bathing is suitable for (the practice of) austerity.

2.3.s: devatās tarpayitvā pitṛtarpaṇam |
2.3.d: देवतास् तर्पयित्वा पितृतर्पणम् ।
2.3.e: The libation to the manes (is offered) after the gods have been satisfied (with water),

2.3.s: anutīrtham apa utsiñcati | ūrjaṃ vahantīr iti |
2.3.d: अनुतीर्थम् अप उत्सिञ्चति । ऊर्जं वहन्तीर् इति ।
2.3.e: They pour out water which gives strength, from one Tīrtha after the other.

2.3.s: athāpy udāharanti | sravantīṣv aniruddhāsu trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ | prātarutthāya kurvīrandevarṣipitṛtarpaṇam |
2.3.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । स्रवन्तीष्व् अनिरुद्धासु त्रयो वर्णा द्विजातयः । प्रातरुत्थाय कुर्वीरन्देवर्षिपितृतर्पणम् ।
2.3.e: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'With flowing, unconfined water twice-born men of the three castes shall satisfy the gods, Ri shis, and manes, when they have risen in the morning.'

2.3.s: niruddhāsu na kurvīrann aṃśabhāk tatra setukṛt |
2.3.d: निरुद्धासु न कुर्वीरन्न् अंशभाक् तत्र सेतुकृत् ।
2.3.e: 'They shall not offer (libations of water) con-fined (in tanks and wells), (If they do it), he who made the embankment; will obtain a share (of the merit of their devotion).'

2.3.s: tasmāt parakṛtān setūn kūpāṃś ca parivarjayed iti |
2.3.d: तस्मात् परकृतान् सेतून् कूपांश् च परिवर्जयेद् इति ।
2.3.e: 'Therefore let him avoid embankments (around tanks) and wells made by others.'

2.3.s: athāpy udāharanti | uddhṛtya vāpi trīn piṇḍān kuryād āpatsu no sadā | niruddhāsu tu mṛtpiṇḍān kūpāt trīn abghaṭāṃs tathā || iti |
2.3.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । उद्धृत्य वापि त्रीन् पिण्डान् कुर्याद् आपत्सु नो सदा । निरुद्धासु तु मृत्पिण्डान् कूपात् त्रीन् अब्घटांस् तथा ॥ इति ।
2.3.e: Nov they quote also (the following verse): 'Or, in times of distress--not as a rule--he may bathe in (water) confined (in tanks), after taking out three lumps (of earth); from a well (let him take three) lumps of clay and three jars of water.'

2.3.s: bahupratigrāhyasyāpratigrāhyasya vā pratigṛhyāyājyaṃ vā yājayitvānāśyānnasya vānnam aśitvā taratsamandīyaṃ japed iti |
2.3.d: बहुप्रतिग्राह्यस्याप्रतिग्राह्यस्य वा प्रतिगृह्यायाज्यं वा याजयित्वानाश्यान्नस्य वान्नम् अशित्वा तरत्समन्दीयं जपेद् इति ।
2.3.e: If he has accepted presents from one who is able to give presents to many, or from one whose presents ought not to be accepted, or if he has sacrificed for one for whom he ought not to have sacrificed, or if he has eaten food (given by a person) whose food must not be eaten, he shall mutter the Taratsamandīya.

2.3.s: athāpy udāharanti | gurusaṃkariṇaś caiva śiṣyasaṃkariṇaś ca ye | āhāramantrasaṃkīrṇā dīrghaṃ tama upāsate || iti |
2.3.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । गुरुसंकरिणश् चैव शिष्यसंकरिणश् च ये । आहारमन्त्रसंकीर्णा दीर्घं तम उपासते ॥ इति ।
2.3.e: Now they quote also (the following verse): Those who improperly associate with (an outcast) teacher, those who improperly associate with (outcast) pupils, and those who improperly associate (with outcasts) by (accepting their) food or by (reciting) Mantras (for them), enter into deep darkness.'

2.3.s: atha snātakavratāni |
2.3.d: अथ स्नातकव्रतानि ।
2.3.e: Now (follow) the duties of a Snātaka.

2.3.s: sāyaṃ prātar yad aśanīyaṃ syāt tenānnena vaiśvadevaṃbalim upahṛtya brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviṭśūdrān abhyāgatān yathāśakti pūjayet |
2.3.d: सायं प्रातर् यद् अशनीयं स्यात् तेनान्नेन वैश्वदेवंबलिम् उपहृत्य ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविट्शूद्रान् अभ्यागतान् यथाशक्ति पूजयेत् ।
2.3.e: After offering at the morning and at the evening (meals) with (a portion of) the food which he may have, the Vaiśvadeva and the Bali-offerings, he shall honour, according to his ability, Brāhmaṇas, Kshatriyas, Vaiśyas, and Śūdras (who may come to his house as) guests.

2.3.s: yadi bahūnāṃ na śaknuyād ekasmai guṇavate dadyāt |
2.3.d: यदि बहूनां न शक्नुयाद् एकस्मै गुणवते दद्यात् ।
2.3.e: If he cannot (afford to give food) to many, let him give (something) to one who possesses good qualities,

2.3.s: yo vā prathamam upagataḥ syāt |
2.3.d: यो वा प्रथमम् उपगतः स्यात् ।

2.3.s: śūdraś ced āgatas taṃ karmaṇi niyuñjyāt |
2.3.d: शूद्रश् चेद् आगतस् तं कर्मणि नियुञ्ज्यात् ।

2.3.s: śrotriyāya vāgraṃ dadyāt |
2.3.d: श्रोत्रियाय वाग्रं दद्यात् ।
2.3.e: Or (if he cannot spare much), he may give a first portion (agrya) to a Śrotriya.

2.3.s: ye nityā bhāktikāḥ syus teṣāmanuparodhena saṃvibhāgo vihitaḥ |
2.3.d: ये नित्या भाक्तिकाः स्युस् तेषामनुपरोधेन संविभागो विहितः ।
2.3.e: It is prescribed that the division (of the food) shall be made without detriment to (the interests of) those who daily receive a portion.

2.3.s: na tv eva kadācid adattvā bhuñjīta |
2.3.d: न त्व् एव कदाचिद् अदत्त्वा भुञ्जीत ।
2.3.e: But he shall never eat without having given away (some small portion of the food).

2.3.s: athāpy atrānnagītau ślokāv udāharanti | yo mām adattvā pitṛdevatābhyobhṛtyātithīnāṃ ca suhṛjjanasya | saṃpannam aśnan viṣam atti mohāt tam admy ahaṃ tasya camṛtyur asmi | hutāgnihotraḥ kṛtavaiśvadevaḥ pūjyātithīn bhṛtyajanāvaśiṣṭam | tuṣṭaḥ śuciḥ śraddadhad atti yo māṃ tasyāmṛtaṃ syāṃsa ca māṃ bhunakti |
2.3.d: अथाप्य् अत्रान्नगीतौ श्लोकाव् उदाहरन्ति । यो माम् अदत्त्वा पितृदेवताभ्योभृत्यातिथीनां च सुहृज्जनस्य । संपन्नम् अश्नन् विषम् अत्ति मोहात् तम् अद्म्य् अहं तस्य चमृत्युर् अस्मि । हुताग्निहोत्रः कृतवैश्वदेवः पूज्यातिथीन् भृत्यजनावशिष्टम् । तुष्टः शुचिः श्रद्दधद् अत्ति यो मां तस्यामृतं स्यांस च मां भुनक्ति ।
2.3.e: Now they quote also two verses which have been proclaimed by (the goddess of) food: 'Him who, without giving me to the gods, the manes, his servants, his guests and friends, consumes what has been prepared and (thus), in his exceeding folly, swallows poison, I consume, and I am his death. But for him who, offering the Agnihotra, performing the Vaiśvadeva, and honouring guests, eats, full of contentment, purity, and faith, what remains after feeding those whom he must support, I become ambrosia, and he (really) enjoys me.'

2.3.s: subrāhmaṇaśrotriyavedapāragebhyogurvarthaniveśauṣadhārthavṛttikṣīṇayakṣyamāṇādhyayanādhvasaṃyogavaiśvajiteṣu dravyasaṃvibhāgo yathāśakti kāryo bahirvedibhikṣamāṇeṣu |
2.3.d: सुब्राह्मणश्रोत्रियवेदपारगेभ्योगुर्वर्थनिवेशौषधार्थवृत्तिक्षीणयक्ष्यमाणाध्ययनाध्वसंयोगवैश्वजितेषु द्रव्यसंविभागो यथाशक्ति कार्यो बहिर्वेदिभिक्षमाणेषु ।
2.3.e: Presents of money must be given, according to one's ability, to good Brāhmaṇas, Śrotriyas, and Vedapāragas, when they beg outside the Vedi, for the sake of Gurus, in order to defray (the expenses of) their marriages, or of medicine, or when they are distressed for a livelihood, or desirous to offer a sacrifice, or engaged in studying, or on a journey, or have performed a Viśva g it sacrifice.

2.3.s: kṛtānnam itareṣu |
2.3.d: कृतान्नम् इतरेषु ।
2.3.e: Cooked food (must be given) to other (beggars).

2.3.s: suprakṣālitapādapāṇir ācāntaḥ śucau saṃvṛte deśe 'nnamupahṛtam upasaṃgṛhya kāmakrodhadrohalobhamohān apahatya sarvābhiraṅgulībhiḥ śabdam akurvan prāśnīyāt |
2.3.d: सुप्रक्षालितपादपाणिर् आचान्तः शुचौ संवृते देशे ऽन्नमुपहृतम् उपसंगृह्य कामक्रोधद्रोहलोभमोहान् अपहत्य सर्वाभिरङ्गुलीभिः शब्दम् अकुर्वन् प्राश्नीयात् ।
2.3.e: Let him eat (seated) in a pure, enclosed place, after having well washed his hands and feet and after having sipped water, respectfully receiving the food which is brought to him, keeping himself free from lust, anger, hatred, greed, and perplexity, (conveying the food into his mouth) with all his fingers and making no noise (during mastication).

2.3.s: na piṇḍaśeṣaṃ pātryām utsṛjet |
2.3.d: न पिण्डशेषं पात्र्याम् उत्सृजेत् ।
2.3.e: Let him not put back into the dish a remnant of food.

2.3.s: māṃsamatsyatilasaṃsṛṣṭaprāśane 'pa upaspṛśyāgnim abhimṛśet |
2.3.d: मांसमत्स्यतिलसंसृष्टप्राशने ऽप उपस्पृश्याग्निम् अभिमृशेत् ।
2.3.e: If he eats (food), containing meat, fish, or sesamum, he shall (afterwards) wash and touch fire,

2.3.s: astamite ca snānam |
2.3.d: अस्तमिते च स्नानम् ।
2.3.e: And bathe after sunset.

2.3.s: pālāśam āsanaṃ pāduke dantadhāvanam iti varjayet |
2.3.d: पालाशम् आसनं पादुके दन्तधावनम् इति वर्जयेत् ।
2.3.e: Let him avoid a seat, clogs, sticks for cleaning the teeth, and other (implements) made of Palāśa wood.

2.3.s: notsaṅge 'nnaṃ bhakṣayet |
2.3.d: नोत्सङ्गे ऽन्नं भक्षयेत् ।
2.3.e: Let him not eat (food placed) in his lap,

2.3.s: āsandyāṃ na bhuñjīta |
2.3.d: आसन्द्यां न भुञ्जीत ।
2.3.e: Nor on a chair,

2.3.s: vaiṇavaṃ daṇḍaṃ dhārayed rukmakuṇḍale ca |
2.3.d: वैणवं दण्डं धारयेद् रुक्मकुण्डले च ।
2.3.e: He shall carry a staff, made of bamboo, and golden earrings.

2.3.s: padā pādasya prakṣālanam adhiṣṭhānaṃ ca varjayet |
2.3.d: पदा पादस्य प्रक्षालनम् अधिष्ठानं च वर्जयेत् ।
2.3.e: Let him not rub one foot with the other while bathing, nor place the one on the other while standing,

2.3.s: na bahirmālāṃ dhārayet |
2.3.d: न बहिर्मालां धारयेत् ।
2.3.e: Let him not wear a visible garland.

2.3.s: sūryam udayāstamaye na nirīkṣeta |
2.3.d: सूर्यम् उदयास्तमये न निरीक्षेत ।
2.3.e: Let him not look at the sun when he rises or sets.

2.3.s: nendradhanur iti parasmai prabrūyāt |
2.3.d: नेन्द्रधनुर् इति परस्मै प्रब्रूयात् ।
2.3.e: Let him not announce (the appearance of a rainbow) to another (man, saying), 'There is Indra's bow.'

2.3.s: yadi brūyān maṇidhanur ity eva brūyāt |
2.3.d: यदि ब्रूयान् मणिधनुर् इत्य् एव ब्रूयात् ।
2.3.e: If he points it out, he shall call it 'the jewelled bow.'

2.3.s: puradvārīndrakīlaparighāv antareṇa nātīyāt |
2.3.d: पुरद्वारीन्द्रकीलपरिघाव् अन्तरेण नातीयात् ।
2.3.e: Let him not pass between the prakīlaka and the beam, at the town gate,

2.3.s: pleṅkhayor antareṇa na gacchet |
2.3.d: प्लेङ्खयोर् अन्तरेण न गच्छेत् ।
2.3.e: Nor let him pass between the two posts of a swing.

2.3.s: vatsatantīṃ ca nopari gacchet |
2.3.d: वत्सतन्तीं च नोपरि गच्छेत् ।
2.3.e: Let him not step over a rope to which a calf is tied.

2.3.s: bhasmāsthiromatuṣakapālāpasnānāni nādhitiṣṭhet |
2.3.d: भस्मास्थिरोमतुषकपालापस्नानानि नाधितिष्ठेत् ।
2.3.e: Let him not step on ashes, bones, hair, chaff, potsherds, nor on a bathing-place (moist with) water.

2.3.s: gāṃ dhayantīṃ na parasmai prabrūyāt |
2.3.d: गां धयन्तीं न परस्मै प्रब्रूयात् ।
2.3.e: Let him not announce it to another (man if) a cow suckles (her calf).

2.3.s: nādhenum adhenur iti brūyāt |
2.3.d: नाधेनुम् अधेनुर् इति ब्रूयात् ।
2.3.e: Let him not say of (a cow which is) not a milch-cow, 'She is not a milch-cow.'

2.3.s: yadi brūyād dhenuṃ bhavyety eva brūyāt |
2.3.d: यदि ब्रूयाद् धेनुं भव्येत्य् एव ब्रूयात् ।
2.3.e: If he speaks (of such a one), let him say, 'It is one which will become a milch-cow.'

2.3.s: śuktā rūkṣāḥ paruṣā vāco na brūyāt |
2.3.d: शुक्ता रूक्षाः परुषा वाचो न ब्रूयात् ।
2.3.e: Let him not make empty, ill-sounding, or harsh speeches.

2.3.s: naiko 'dhvānaṃ vrajet |
2.3.d: नैको ऽध्वानं व्रजेत् ।
2.3.e: Let him not go alone on a. journey,

2.3.s: na patitair na striyā na śūdreṇa |
2.3.d: न पतितैर् न स्त्रिया न शूद्रेण ।
2.3.e: Nor with outcasts, nor with a woman, nor with a Śūdra.

2.3.s: na pratisāyaṃ vrajet |
2.3.d: न प्रतिसायं व्रजेत् ।
2.3.e: Let him not set out (on a journey) towards evening.

2.3.s: na nagnaḥ snāyāt |
2.3.d: न नग्नः स्नायात् ।
2.3.e: Let him not bathe (entirely) naked.

2.3.s: na naktaṃ snāyāt |
2.3.d: न नक्तं स्नायात् ।
2.3.e: Let him not bathe at night.

2.3.s: na nadīṃ bāhukas taret |
2.3.d: न नदीं बाहुकस् तरेत् ।
2.3.e: Let him not cross a river swimming.

2.3.s: na kūpam avekṣeta |
2.3.d: न कूपम् अवेक्षेत ।
2.3.e: Let him not look down into a well.

2.3.s: na gartam avekṣeta |
2.3.d: न गर्तम् अवेक्षेत ।
2.3.e: Let him not look down into a pit.

2.3.s: na tatropaviśed yata enam anya utthāpayet |
2.3.d: न तत्रोपविशेद् यत एनम् अन्य उत्थापयेत् ।
2.3.e: Let him not sit down there, where another person may order him to rise.

2.3.s: panthā deyo brāhmaṇāya gave rājñe hy acakṣuṣe | vṛddhāya bhārataptāya garbhiṇyai durbalāya ca |
2.3.d: पन्था देयो ब्राह्मणाय गवे राज्ञे ह्य् अचक्षुषे । वृद्धाय भारतप्ताय गर्भिण्यै दुर्बलाय च ।
2.3.e: Way must be made for a Brāhmaṇa, a cow, a king, a blind man, an aged man, one who is suffering under a burden, a pregnant woman, and a weak man.

2.3.s: prabhūtaidhodakayavasasamitkuśamālyopaniṣkramaṇamāḍhyajanākulam analasasamṛddham āryajanabhūyiṣṭhamadasyupraveśyaṃ grāmam āvasituṃ yateta dhārmikaḥ |
2.3.d: प्रभूतैधोदकयवससमित्कुशमाल्योपनिष्क्रमणमाढ्यजनाकुलम् अनलससमृद्धम् आर्यजनभूयिष्ठमदस्युप्रवेश्यं ग्रामम् आवसितुं यतेत धार्मिकः ।
